m920064.……天使長！！ \nなぜ分からないのですか……？\n本当はもう気が付いているはず:
…Archangel!!
Why can't you understand…?
You should already have realized the truth…!
m920064.……永い封印の時を経ても尚、\n貴方は、純粋で、疑うことを、\n知らずにいるので:
…Even after ages of sealing,
you remain pure, never knowing doubt.
m920064.……王子、ご相談があります。\n私を貴方たちの仲間として頂けないでしょうか。\n: …Prince, I have a request. Will you accept me as one of your allies? I want to protect the people under your banner.
m920064.……私を、そのような目で、見ないで下さい。\nこれは、神意なのです。私は、間違っ:
…Please, don't look at me that way.
This is the divine will. I am not mistaken…
Never mistaken…
m920064.……貴方には、迷いがないのですね。己の信念\nに裏打ちされた瞳が、ただ美しい……: …You have no doubt. Your eyes, backed by conviction, are simply beautiful… I too want to be beautiful… to be righteous…
m920064.あ、あなたは！？\nこれまで見てきた天使とは、\n何だか違うような気がするけど…:
Huh, you're…? 
You don't seem like any angel I've ever seen before…
m920064.あの天使は……！\n王子、お気を付けください！\nあの天使は他の天使を癒す力を持:
That angel…!
Prince, be careful!
That angel can heal other angels!
m920064.あの魔神たち、まだ諦めてないってわけね。\n……まぁ、それもそうか。\n永遠の混: Those demon lords haven't given up yet, have they? …Well, that's to be expected. Seeking eternal chaos is a demon's nature.
m920064.あら？\n誰かと思えば……あなた天使に操られて\nいた小娘ね。アタシはこっそり見: Oh? If it's you… the little girl who was being puppeted by angels. I've been watching you quietly.
m920064.あ～あ、今度は天使かぁ。\n人間や魔物と違ってやっかいなんだよなぁ～。\nでも安: Ah, an angel this time. Unlike humans or monsters, they're such a hassle… But don't worry, Milno. If it's me—.
m920064.いいのです、クロエ。\n私はもう天使長ではなく、\n堕天使ミルノ……なのですから: It's fine, Chloe. I'm no longer the Angel Chief; I'm Fallen Angel Milno… after all.
m920064.いつまでも、クロエに\n甘えるわけにはいきませんから……。: I can't keep indulging you forever, Chloe…
m920064.えっ……！？\nどうして神様がそんな命令を？！:
Wh—!?
Why would the gods give such an order…?!
m920064.おい！\n悩んでいる場合ではないぞ！\n天使達が次々に地上へ向かっているぞ！:
Hey!
This isn't the time to be hesitating!
The angels are heading to the surface one after another!
m920064.おっと、お喋りしてる暇はないみたいだね。\n戦う姿を見られたくはなかったけど……: Looks like we don't have time for chit-chat. I didn't want to see you fight, but… if this is fate, I'll obey.
m920064.おや……こんな所にも人間がいたのですね。\nそのように息を荒げて、\nいったいど:
???: Oh… so there are still humans here, huh?
Breathing so heavily like that,
what brings you here?
m920064.この黒く穢れた羽と醜い角こそが、\n堕天使である証であり、罪なのです。\nこんな: These black, tainted wings and ugly horns are the very proof—and the sin—of being a fallen angel. Please… don't stare at me so much…
m920064.これでもう逃げられないぜ！\nいったいどれ程大層なお宝を隠してんだ？！: Now you can't run away! How much precious treasure are you hiding?!
m920064.こんな穢れた羽をもった私に、\nそのような言葉は勿体ないです……。: Such words are a waste for someone with these tainted wings…
m920064.さぁ！ 王子！\n天使たちを追いかけますわよ！:
Come on! Prince!
Let's chase those angels!
m920064.さあ、時は満ちた。\n人の子らよ、私に力を貸してくれ！\n眼前のデーモン達を滅す: Now the time has come. Children of men, lend me your strength! We'll crush the demons before us… Let's go!
m920064.さっき天使たちが言っていた言葉だね……。\nその言葉は何を意味しているの？: That's what the angels were saying earlier… What does that mean?
m920064.し、しかし……神の命じられたことです……。\n私がそれに背くなど……主は、間違わ:
B-but… this is what God commanded.
How could I defy that… the Lord never makes mistakes.
He shouldn't be wrong… yet…
m920064.じゃあ神様が人間を滅ぼそうとしてるって事？！\nそんなの嘘だよ！\nそんなこと…:
So the gods are trying to wipe out humans?!
That's a lie!
That could never be true…!
m920064.すごい……あれほどの敵を\nああも容易く倒してしまうなんて……。: Incredible… to defeat such foes so easily…
m920064.そうですね。\nそれに、追ってきた天使たちの事も気になります。\n王子、少し後を: That's right. And I'm also concerned about the angels chasing us. Prince, let's follow a bit behind.
m920064.そうねぇ……天使はいないわねぇ。\nだけど、あなたの前にはクイーンがいるの。\n:
Well… there are no angels, huh.
But standing before you is the Queen.
Yes, this Goblin Queen, you see… Heh heh.
m920064.そして、かつての仲間であったエルンとの\n出会いと、彼女の言葉によって、\n私は: Then, meeting my former comrade Ern and hearing her words, I came to understand my own mistake….
m920064.そのように殺気立たれて、\n一体どうしたというのですか？\n困ったことがあればお: With such murderous intent, what's the matter? If you're in trouble, I'll lend you my aid.
m920064.その意気よぉ。\nさあ、アタシの計画をつぶしてくれた王子たち\nの大切なものを全: That's the spirit. Now, I'll take everything precious to those princes who ruined my plan, hehe…
m920064.その言葉、大変嬉しく思います。\n私達は、ミルノさんを歓迎致します。\nこれから: I'm truly honored by your words. We welcome you, Milno. From now on, please look after us.
m920064.それでもいいのに……ううん、何でもない。\n今まで楽しかったよ、ミルノ。: Even so, it's okay… no, never mind. It's been fun, Milno.
m920064.それは……。\n地上の生態系の一部に介入する事……。\nすなわち「1つの種族を滅:
It's…
Intervening in part of the Earth's ecosystem…
In other words, a command to “eradicate an entire species.”
m920064.それは、神に背かなくては叶わない、\n私の願いとなってしまった……。\nだから、:
That desire became a wish I could only fulfill by defying the gods…
So I fell….
m920064.そんな……。\n王子、今は彼らと戦うしかないようです。: No… Prince, it seems we have no choice but to fight them now.
m920064.そんな……。本当に私達を、滅ぼす気なのですね。\nこのままでは街が……。\n王子:
No… you really intend to destroy us?
If this goes on, the town…
Prince, we have no choice but to stand against them…
m920064.そんなこと……させません！\nミルノは人を護ると決めたのです。大天使長で\nあろ: I won't let that happen! Milno decided to protect people. Even if you're the Archangel, I won't let you stand in her way!
m920064.そんなこと気にしないでよ！\nねえ、ずっとここにいなよ？\n私が護ってあげるから: Don't worry about that! Hey, stay here forever, okay? I'll protect you. You have nothing to worry about.
m920064.そんな言葉には騙されない。\nてこでもここを動くつもりはないんだからね。: I won't be swayed by those words. I have no intention of moving from here.
m920064.ただ美しく、正しくあるようにと、\n私はいっさいの迷い無く、仲間たちに\n人間を: I commanded my comrades to kill humans without a hint of doubt, so they might remain beautiful and righteous.
m920064.ですが、それまで知識としてしかなかった\n神罰の真の姿を目の当たりにすると、\n: But when I witnessed the true nature of divine punishment, which I'd only known as theory, doubt arose within me.
m920064.どうやら危機は脱したようです。\nミルノさん、大丈夫ですか？！: Looks like we've gotten out of the crisis. Milno, are you alright?!
m920064.な、なぜそれを……ッ！？\nですが、今は天使はいません！\nもうアタシは誰にも屈:
Why… why would you…!?
But there are no angels now!
I won't bow to anyone any longer!!
m920064.な、なんですかこれは……。\nどうやらグスタフさんの言っていたことは\n本当のよ: W-what is this… It seems Gustav was right… What on earth for…?
m920064.なぜ……天使長である私が、\n人間などに……負けるの、ですか……？\nわからない:
Why… why does the Archangel… have to lose to humans…?
I don't understand… I can't grasp it…
m920064.なぜ抗うのですか？ \n神の御心による滅びは、ただ美しく、\n優しさに満ちあふれ:
Why do you resist?
The destruction ordained by the divine is beautiful,
filled with kindness…
m920064.なのに、なぜ私はこんなにも心乱れて……。\n胸が……苦しい……これまで耳にしてい:
And yet, why is my heart so torn…?
My chest… it hurts… the divine punishment I've heard of is such a cruel act…
m920064.ならばこの光景は何なのですか！？\n見なさい、貴方達が産み落とした戦火を！\nこ: Then what is this sight? Look at the war you have birthed! If this isn't hell, what else would you call it!!
m920064.はぁ……はぁ……何とか、助かりましたわ。\n前にもこんなこと、あったのに……、\:
Hah… huff… I somehow made it through.
I've been in this kind of situation before, and…
I'm still so inexperienced…
m920064.はぅぅ……ようやく、身体の自由が戻りましたわ。\nもう、誰かに身体を好き勝手され:
Haa… finally, my body is free again.
I won't let anyone use my body as they please any more…
So many… ha….
m920064.はかなき人の子よ……。\n未熟な精神なれば……。\n操るのは……容易い。:
Fleeting child of man…
Your spirit is immature…
It's… easy to control.
m920064.はなせッ、はなせよぉー！！\nせっかくできた仲間を、人間なんかに\n傷つけさせた: Stop it, stop! I won't let the comrades we just made get hurt by humans!
m920064.ふぅ……ま、こんなところかなっ？\n貴方達もけっこー良かったよ。\n人間と一緒に: Phew… I guess that's it. You all were pretty great. Fighting alongside humans isn't so bad.
m920064.ふっ……名乗るべき名などないわ。\nだけど、強いて言うならば……パフィリア。\n: Heh… I have no name to give. But if I must… Parhelia. Yes! People call me the fallen angel Parhelia!
m920064.べ、別になにも隠してない！\n（どうしよう。あの人間たち絶対に\n気が付いてる…: I-I'm not hiding anything! (What should I do? Those humans will definitely notice…! If it comes to this…)
m920064.まさか……これが、神罰……なのですか？\n悲鳴、怒号、絶望、恐怖……ここは、おか:
No… could this really be divine punishment?
Screams, shouts, despair, fear… something's wrong here.
Everything's in chaos; there's no beauty at all…
m920064.まだ理解できていないようですね。\nこの堕天使だけでなく、貴方を堕落させた\n人: It seems you still don't understand. Not only this fallen angel, but also the humans who corrupted you—all are sins that must be punished.
m920064.まーたそんなこと言ってぇ～！ \n私にとってはミルノはずっと天使長なんだから！\: There you go again! To me, Milno will always be the Archangel! Don't forget that.
m920064.もうッ！！ 帰る気がないんなら、\n容赦なく返り討ちにしてやるんだから！\nほら: Enough! If you won't leave, I'll crush you without mercy! Come on, everyone's turn!
m920064.もぉーッ！\nまた人間達が邪魔しに来たの～？\n何人来たってここは通さないんだか: Ugh! Humans are meddling again? No matter how many come, I won't let anyone pass!
m920064.アナタ、勝ち気ないい顔をしているわぁ……。\nさあ、アタシの目をみなさい……ウフ:
You have such a determined look on your face…
Now, look into my eyes… Heh heh.
m920064.ウフフ……このあたりの岩盤は全て\n爆弾で破壊できたようねぇ。: Heh heh… Looks like we managed to blast every rock slab around here.
m920064.ウフフ……な～んにも知らないのね。\nまあ、知らない方がいいこともあるわ。\nそ: Heh heh… You really don't know anything, do you? Well, sometimes ignorance is bliss. I'll be taking my leave now.
m920064.ウフフ……ようやくのご対面ね。\nさあ、共に人間たちを滅ぼしましょう？: Heh heh… At last we meet. Shall we destroy the humans together?
m920064.ウフフ……早速、騒ぎを聞きつけたのかしら？\nだけど、一足遅かったみたいねぇ。\: Heh heh… Heard the commotion already? But you're a bit late. The seal's already been released.
m920064.エイユウ！ タオス！ 街、襲ウ！\nエイユウ！ タオス！ 街、襲ウ！: Heroes! Taos! Attack the town! Heroes! Taos! Attack the town!
m920064.エルン……。分かったよ。\n王子、天使長が話を聞いてくれるまで\n頑張るしかない:
Erun… I get it.
Prince, we have no choice but to keep fighting until the Archangel will listen!
m920064.エルンさん。\nあの天使たちの事を知っているのですか？: Erun… Do you know anything about those angels?
m920064.ギャギャッ……人間、タオス！\nアイツ、護ル！ 人間、タオス！: Gya-gya… Humans, Tao! Protect them! Humans, Tao!
m920064.ギャギャッ……壊シタ、壊シタ！\n封印トイタ、人間タオセル！: Gya-gya… It's broken, it's broken! The seal's gone, humans are doomed!
m920064.クロエ……もうよいのです。\n彼らは、敵ではありません。: Chloe… it's alright now. They're not enemies.
m920064.クロエも無事で良かった……。\n王子、ありがとう……心から感謝します。: I'm glad Chloe is safe too… Prince, thank you… I'm truly grateful.
m920064.クロエ！\n……彼女は、関係ありません……大天使長様！\n罰せられるべきは私のは: Chloe! …She has nothing to do with this, Archangel! I'm the one who should be punished!
m920064.グッ、ぅう……このようなことが……ばかな。\n薄汚れた堕天使などに、この私が、負: Guh… ugh… this… absurd. A filthy fallen angel, and I—losing? Impossible… it can't be…
m920064.ゴブリンクイーン様に逆らう人間たちは、\n貴方たちですか？\n覚悟しなさい！:
Those who defy you, Goblin Queen… are you?
Prepare yourselves!
m920064.シャルロットさん……。またですか。\nですが、そんな気もしていたので大丈夫です。:
Charlotte… again?
But I had a feeling, so I'm fine.
Come on, Prince, let's go.
m920064.ドロシーさん……気持ちを強くお持ち下さい。\n天使長は私達の心の声を聞いてくれる:
Dorothy… stay strong in your heart.
The Archangel will hear the voice of our souls.
He'll… he'll surely understand.
m920064.ミルノ……。\nやっぱり……行っちゃうの？: Milno… So… are you really leaving?
m920064.ミルノ、しばらくは皆と一緒にいませんか？\n独りでいるよりも、幾分かは\n安全な: Milno, why don't you stay with us for a while? It's safer than being alone, at least somewhat.
m920064.ミルノぉ～！！\n怖かったよぉ……でも、大天使長を退けられた\nんだね……よかっ: Milno!! That was scary… but we drove the Archangel away, didn't we? Thank goodness… thank goodness!
m920064.ミルノさん……天使達の襲撃は何とか退け\nましたが、これで終わったようには思えま: Miruno… we managed to repel the angels' assault, but I don't think it's over. Prince, let's return and prepare for what's coming.
m920064.ミルノさんもクロエも、\n絶対に死なせたりしません！\n王子、戦いのご準備を！: We won't let Milno or Chloe die! Prince, prepare for battle!
m920064.ミルノさん！\nお願いです！ 天使達を止めてください！\nこのままでは、本当に全:
Miruno! Please! Stop the angels!
If this keeps going, everyone… will…!?
m920064.ミルノ！？\n何故このようなところに？\nそれにその姿は……。: Milno!? Why are you here? And that form…
m920064.一時の気の迷いに惑わされ堕天するとは……。\n実に嘆かわしいですね。\n天使長ミ: To fall because of a momentary lapse of mind… how lamentable. Angel Chief Milno.
m920064.一緒に、ミルノの後を追ってくれないかな……。\nミルノがずっと自分の中に深い罪を: Could you come with me and follow Milno? I don't want her to carry that deep guilt forever, beating herself up…
m920064.主よ……ここにざんげします。私は、貴方ではなく、\n己に従うことを選びました……: Lord… I repent here. I chose to follow myself, not you… Please forgive this heart born suddenly, and my love for humanity…
m920064.事実、私達は天使の軍団を率いて人間の\n住む街を襲撃しました。: In fact, we led an army of angels to assault the towns where humans lived.
m920064.人間には原罪が内包されるのと同時に、愛があ\nります。それは、天使や神すら持ち合:
Humans carry original sin, but they also carry love.
Isn't that the one shining light this world has—something even angels and gods lack?
m920064.人間を……確認。\nこれより、神の命令により、\n人間達を……浄化する。: Human… confirmed. By divine command, we shall now purify the humans.
m920064.今からでも遅くはありません。\n共に、浄化の光をもって、この地を清めるのです。:
It's not too late yet.
Together, with the purifying light, we shall cleanse this land.
m920064.仲間……？\nやはり誰かを庇っていたのですね。: Comrades…? So you were protecting someone after all.
m920064.何で、目覚めた天使達が攻撃をしてくるの？\n魔物と違って、私達の\n味方だと思っ: Why are the awakened angels attacking? Unlike monsters, I thought they were on our side…
m920064.何故来たのですかッ……？！\n……そうか、これが無償の愛……人間には\nやはり天: Why did you come…?! …I see, this is selfless love… something humans have that angels lack—a sparkle…
m920064.全く……。\nこうも簡単に魔界の門が開くなんてね。: Good grief… to think the demon gate opened so easily.
m920064.全ては神の御心のままに……。\nあれは、この身に刻まれたただ一つの信念に\n裏打:
All according to the will of the gods…
That was a merciless purge, backed by the single conviction engraved upon me.
m920064.全ては神の御心のままに……。\nさあ天使たちよ。\n普く光を以て、粛清を始めまし: All according to God's will… Come, angels. With blinding light, let the purge begin.
m920064.全てを……お話しいたします。\nいつ誰が来るか分かりません。\n場所を変えましょ: I'll tell you everything. We never know who might show up. Let's change locations.
m920064.千年戦争の時に神が下した命令は\n未だに天使達を縛りつけているのですね……。\n:
The command the god gave during the Millennium War
still binds the angels, doesn't it…?
Archangel, long time no see.
m920064.千年戦争の際に女神アイギスによって施された\n封印から目覚めた私は、かつて神に命: Having awakened from the seal the goddess Aegis placed during the Millennium War, I, who was once tasked by the gods, sought to eradicate humanity.
m920064.問答無用、というわけですね。\n王子、戦いのご準備を！: So it's a no-questions-asked fight. Prince, prepare for battle!
m920064.地上に堕ちた時に記憶を一部失ったので\nはっきりとは思い出せないのですが、\nか: When I fell, I lost part of my memory, so I can't recall clearly, but I faintly remember the phrase “purify.”
m920064.堕天使……。\n先日、天使達の封印が解かれたことと\n何か関係があるのでしょうか: A fallen angel… Could it be connected to the recent unsealing of the angels?
m920064.堕天使どもの手先か……？ \n命令遂行の妨害をするならば排除する。:
Servants of the fallen angels…?
If you hinder the execution of our orders, we will eliminate you.
m920064.堕天使に身をやつした者の言うことなど……。: The words of someone who's become a fallen…
m920064.大丈夫です……私がついています。\n自らの心奥に問いかけるのです……。\n貴方の: It's okay… I'm with you. Ask the depths of your own heart… What does your heart scream it wants to do?
m920064.天使たち、撤退していきます。\n何とか、ミルノさん達を護れたようですね。: Angels, retreat. It looks like we managed to protect Milno and the others.
m920064.天使たち、私は浄化を受け入れます。\n穢れた私は浄化されるべき存在です……。: Angels, I accept purification. The tainted me should be cleansed…
m920064.天使だか何だか知りませんが、アタシの\n魔法剣で、足止めしてさしあげますわッ！: I don't know if you're angels or what, but I'll halt you with my magic sword!
m920064.天使との争いは続いていくのでしょうね……。\nですが、ミルノさんのような天使がい: The conflict with the angels will surely continue… But we must never forget that angels like you exist. Prince, thank you for your efforts.
m920064.天使の皆さん、どうか侵攻を止めてください！\n私達の話を聞いてください！:
Angels, please stop your invasion!
Listen to us!
m920064.天使達がゴブリン達と一緒に向かってくるよ！ \nもしかして、\nゴブリンクイーン: The angels are heading toward us with the goblins! Could they be being controlled by the Goblin Queen?!
m920064.天使達が戦闘態勢にはいりました！\n王子、ミルノさんを護りましょう！: The angels have taken battle positions! Prince, let's protect Milno!
m920064.天使達に操られてるんだ！\n天使たちの力なら、\n未熟な人間を操ることは不可能じ:
They're being controlled by the angels!
With an angel's power, manipulating an inexperienced human isn't impossible!
m920064.天使達の力は人間には推し量れない\n特殊なものなので仕方ありません。\n元気出し:
The angels' power is a special force beyond human comprehension, so there's nothing we can do.
Stay strong, Charlotte.
m920064.天使達の攻撃すら退けるなんて、\nあの王子の力は計り知れないわねぇ……。\nでも: Even repelling the angels' attacks— that prince's power is immeasurable… But you'd be wrong to think I'd step back because of that.
m920064.天使長……そこに貴方の意思はありますか？: Archangel… do you truly have a will of your own?
m920064.天使長……私は私の意思をもって、貴方を止め\nます！ これこそが堕天した者にしか:
Archangel… I will stop you of my own will!
This is a duty only a fallen one can fulfill, and now I finally understand it clearly!
m920064.天使長様。計画は問題無く進んでおります。\nすべてはあのお方の御心のままに。:
Archangel, the plan is proceeding without issue.
Everything unfolds according to His will.
m920064.天使長！？\nでしたら、天使達に今すぐ進軍を止めるように\n命じてください。この:
Archangel!?
If so, please order the angels to halt their advance at once.
If this continues, the town…
m920064.待って下さいミルノさん！\n一人ではいずれ天使達に捕まってしまいます。\n私達と: Please wait, Milno! On your own you'll eventually be captured by the angels. Shouldn't we stick together?
m920064.怪しいな……？\nさてはお前、何か隠しているだろ？\nお宝か？: Suspicious… Are you hiding something? Treasure, perhaps?
m920064.恐れることはありません。人の子らよ。\n全ては美しき世界への懸け橋……。\n死は:
Fear not, children of men.
All is a bridge to a beautiful world…
Death is merely a beginning.
m920064.悲しまないでくれ、美しき人の子よ。\n私は孤高の堕天使……。\n在るべき場所へ、: Don't be sad, beautiful child of humanity. I am the lone fallen angel… I have to go to where I belong.
m920064.愛……？ わからない……私には、そのような\nもの……いいえ、天使長である私が神: Love…? I don't understand… I… no, as the Archangel I must never doubt God… I must not…
m920064.戦うことは、避けられないのですね……。\n王子……ミルノさんを迎え撃ちましょう。:
So fighting is inevitable…
Prince… let's meet Miruno head-on.
m920064.手始めに貴方の前で、\nまずはこの堕天使を浄化するとしましょう。: To start, right here before you, I shall first purify this fallen angel.
m920064.操られやすいのはいいことだけど、\nいまいち使えない小娘だったわねぇ。\nまあい:
It's fine that you're easy to control, but you were a rather useless little girl.
Well, never mind, I'll look forward to the next one….
m920064.改めて、自己紹介させていただきます。\n私は天使長ミルノ……いえ。\n今は堕天使:
Allow me to reintroduce myself.
I am the Angelic Commander Miruno… no.
Now I'm Fallen Angel Milno, right.
m920064.敵、攻撃を停止しました。\nですが、破砕した岩盤の奥から、天使達が\n更に出現し: The enemy has ceased its attack. However, from within the shattered rock, more angels are appearing…
m920064.機会があったらまた会おう。\n運命が交わっていれば、\n再会できるかもね……じゃ: If we get the chance, let's meet again. If fate brings us together, we might reunite… See you!
m920064.気遣いは無用ですわッ！\nこの汚名は、これからの戦いにて、\n絶対にそそがせてい:
No need for concern!
I'll turn this disgrace into fuel for the battles ahead!
m920064.永らく封じられていた我が身ですが……、\nどうやら力は衰えていないようです。\n:
???: Though I have been sealed for ages…
It seems my power has not waned.
Fulfilling the god's command will be easy.
m920064.浄化の対象は……人間です。: The target of purification… is humanity.
m920064.火の海と化した街には、無数の悲鳴と怒号が\n溢れ、そこに美しさなどありはしません: The city turned to a sea of fire, filled with countless screams and shouts—there was no beauty left.
m920064.王子……、\n神の意志は天使にとって絶対です。\n迎え撃つしかありません……。:
Prince…
The will of the gods is absolute to the angels.
We have no choice but to meet it head-on…
m920064.王子、あの天使達は危険な気がします……。\nもし、かつて神からの指令を受けていた: Prince, those angels feel dangerous… If they once carried out orders from the gods, this could be serious.
m920064.王子、こっちじゃ！\nゴブリン達が我ら一族に伝わる封印を\nメチャメチャにしおっ: Prince, over here! The goblins have completely ruined the seal handed down in our clan!
m920064.王子、天使たちを追いかけましょう。\n彼らは危険です。:
Prince, let's chase after the angels.
They're dangerous.
m920064.王子！ あそこに天使たちが……！\nそんな……天使達が、街を襲っている……。\n:
Prince! Look, the angels are down there…!
They're attacking the town…
Could this be some kind of nightmare?
m920064.皆さんの言葉が……胸に響くようです。\nこんなに暖かな気持ちになったことは、\n: Your words… they resonate deep within me. I've never felt such warmth before.
m920064.目の前の光景をしっかりと見てください、\n天使長！ これが、あなたが仕える、\n:
Look closely at the scene before you, Archangel!
This is the true heart of the one you serve, the one called God!
m920064.目的地に到着！\nこの一帯にて、堕天使が暴れているとの\n報告を受けております。: We've arrived at the destination! We've received reports that a fallen angel is rampaging in this area.
m920064.祈れ、地上の子らよ。\nこれは、神の剣による断罪だ。:
Pray, children of the earth.
This is judgment by the Sword of God.
m920064.神と魔神に人間かぁ……。\nまぁ、各々の思惑なんて知ったことじゃないし、\n私は: Gods, demon lords, and humans… I don't care about anyone's motives; I'll just follow my own sense of justice.
m920064.神に従い、自らを偽るか……。\n神に背き、自らを正すか……。\nミルノ……苦しく: Obey God and lie to yourself… or defy God and set yourself right… Miruno… even if it hurts, you have to choose.
m920064.私からもお願いします。\n天使にとって堕天とは、恥ずべき大罪……。\n清廉なミル: I'll ask too. For angels, a fall is a shameful sin… I wonder if pure Milno can endure…
m920064.私がここにいては、いつまでも皆さんに\n迷惑をかけてしまいます。天使の追っ手たち: If I stay here, I'll keep troubling you forever. The angels' pursuers are getting desperate…
m920064.私は……世界が美しくあって欲しい……。\nそして、私は正しく……ありたいのです…: I want the world to remain beautiful… And I want to be righteous… To do that… must I betray?
m920064.私は……助けたい……人を、助けたいと、\n願ってしまっている……こんな、ことって: I… I want to help… I want to save people… I wish that… but I don't want to see a hell like this…
m920064.私は……大丈夫です。\nクロエにも怪我はなかったです。\nありがとうございます。: I'm… fine. Chloe wasn't injured either. Thank you.
m920064.私は天使長ミルノ。\n天の御使い達を統べる者。\n主の命によって此の地にやってき:
I am Miruno, Archangel.
Leader of the heavenly messengers.
I have come to this land by the Lord's command.
m920064.私もエルンさんと一緒の気持ちだよ。\nミルノさんは、天使であった時よりも、\n今: I feel the same as Erun. Milno, you shine even more now than when you were an angel. Truly, you're the Archangel.
m920064.私も貴方のようにあの方を信じていました。\nですがあの方は、人間を罰するべき愚物:
I, too, believed in Him like you did.
But He decided that humanity should be punished, a foolish judgment,
and never even tried to see them.
m920064.私？ そうねぇ。\nただの通りすがりの天使だよ。\nま、堕ちてしまった翼の穢れた: Me? Hmm… just a passing angel. Well, a fallen angel with tainted wings, actually.
m920064.穢れた天使……浄化する……。\n堕天使を……浄化せよ……。: Defiled angel… shall be purified… Fallen angel… be purified…
m920064.見つけた……ミルノ……。\n裏切り者の……堕天使……。: I've found you… Milno… the traitor… the fallen angel…
m920064.誰かを護りたいという強い想いが、王子や私達を\n動かしたのです。\n天使長の崇高: Our fierce desire to protect someone moved the Prince and us. We pay our respects to the Archangel's lofty spirit.
m920064.誰が未熟ですってぇ――ふぁッ！？\nか、勝手に魔法剣が発動しちゃいましたわ！\n:
Who says I'm inexperienced—!?
My magic sword just activated on its own!
…Please, someone stop this—!!
m920064.護りたいと……思ってしまったのです。\n人を、この地に溢れる美しい自然を……。: I began to want to protect… people, the beautiful nature overflowing this land….
m920064.貴方の心は、もう理解してしまって\nいるのではありませんか？ 神にではなく、\n: Your heart has already come to understand, hasn't it? That it's not God but humanity that should be the light we trust…
m920064.貴方は……エルン……？ そう、貴方ほどの\n天使が、地に堕ちてしまったのですね…:
You are… Erun…? Yes, an angel of your stature
has fallen to the earth…
An angel is only an angel when they guide humanity.
m920064.貴方は……大天使長様……。\nいずれ、貴方が来ると思っていました。\n全ての天使: You… Archangel… I knew you'd come here someday. The one who watches over every angel and punishes their sins…
m920064.貴方は尊きものの典型であったのに……。\n知恵に満ち、美の極みであったはずなのに: You were once the very model of nobility… full of wisdom, the pinnacle of beauty… I will punish everything that led you astray.
m920064.逃げられてしまいましたね……。\nですが、この状況は一体どういうこと\nなのでし: They got away… But what on earth is going on here?
m920064.魔物が暴れているという報告があったのは、\nどうやらこの辺りみたいですね。\n皆: We've received reports of monsters—looks like it's around here. Everyone, stay on high alert!

m920091.――……あなた達、\n本当にすっごく強いんだね。\n私なんかじゃ手も足もでない。:
???: ――……You all are truly incredibly strong.
I'm no match for you.
m920091.――……こっちから、欠片の気配を感じる。\nそれも一つや二つじゃない、\n結構な:
――…I can feel the fragment's presence from this side.
It's not just one or two—there's a sizable collection of them.
m920091.――あぁッ、ボクの風神が……せっかく\n落魂陣で操ったっていうのに。\n本当に、: Ahh, my Wind God… even though I carefully controlled it with the Fallen Soul Formation. You guys are always getting in the way!
m920091.――あの、大丈夫ですか？\nこの様な所にお一人で一体何を？: —Um, are you okay? What are you doing alone out here?
m920091.――お待たせレシア、\n皆をつれてきたよ！: —Sorry to keep you waiting, Resia. I've brought everyone!
m920091.――そこの方、もう大丈夫です、ご安心ください。\n……王子、報告にあった巨人の痕: —Sir, it's alright now, please don't worry. …Prince, the giant tracks from the report turned out to be Gigars after all.
m920091.――だいぶ欠片も集まりましたね。\n一刻も早く風神を止める必要があります。\n皆: —We've gathered quite a few fragments. We need to stop the Wind God as soon as possible. Everyone, let's hurry!
m920091.――どうしてそんな大変な事になってるのに\nわたしに何も相談してくれないんだよぉ: Why didn't you tell me anything, even though it's such a huge deal! If you'd said, I'd have helped too!
m920091.――なんだよ、こんな所に連れてきて。\nあ、もしかして手合わせでもしてくれんのか: ――What the heck, bringing me to a place like this? Hey, are you challenging me to a duel or something?! Perfect timing, my skills have been getting rusty lately!
m920091.――何故このような所に人間が。\nもしや、我らの目的に勘付いたか。\nおい、そこ: —Why is a human in a place like this? Perhaps they've caught wind of our purpose. Hey, you girl over there.
m920091.――協力してくれてありがとう。\nこのお礼は、必ずするから。:
—Thanks for cooperating.
I'll be sure to repay you.
m920091.――報告、妖怪の群れが\n間もなく交戦距離に入ります！: Report— a horde of youkai will be within engagement range any moment!
m920091.――報告！ サハギンの群れが\n船に接近している模様！\n戦闘の準備をお願いしま:
—Report! A school of sahagin is approaching the ship!
Prepare for battle!!
m920091.――報告！ 妖怪の群れが、\n再び接近してきているとの事です！！: ――Report! A horde of youkai is approaching again!!
m920091.――妖天君には逃げられましたか。\n相変わらず、逃げ足の速い奴ですね。: —Did Yotenkun get away? He's still as quick on his feet as ever.
m920091.――待ってラミィ、落ち着いて。\nどうして怒ってるの？: Wait, Ramii, calm down. Why are you so angry?
m920091.――既に風神を取り戻した気でいるとは。\n呑気なものだな。: ――You already think you've reclaimed the Wind God? How carefree of you.
m920091.……あぁー、ゴチャゴチャうるせぇ！\n邪仙だかなんだか知らねーが、オレはファーだ: ……Ugh, shut up already! I don't care about any of that “evil immortal” nonsense—I'm Far! Nothing else matters!!
m920091.……ううん、本当は、皆といれば父様の仇を\n討てるかもって、そう思ってる。: …No, actually, if I'm with everyone I think I might finally be able to avenge my father.
m920091.……うん、多分考えてる通り。\n私はフーコ……風神の娘だよ。:
…yeah, probably just as I thought.
I'm Fuuko… the Wind God's daughter.
m920091.……うん。だから、父様を解放する為に\nこうして定風珠の欠片を集めに――: Yeah. So, to free my father, I'm gathering the fragments of the Jōfū Jewel like this—
m920091.……え？ 何今の声……って、\nで……デカッ！ 何あれ巨人！？\nお、お願い食べ: …Huh? Whose voice was that just now…? And… wow! What's that, a giant!? P-please don't eat me~~!!
m920091.……おい、一目連。\n幼馴染の親父をやっておいて、\n何とも思わねぇのかよ。: …Hey, Ichimokuren. Acting like a dad to your childhood friend, and you feel nothing?
m920091.……お願い王子、\n奴より先に定風珠の欠片を集めて、\n父様を解放するのに協力し:
…Please, Prince,
collect the Teifūju fragments before he does and help free my father.
m920091.……だから、どうするかは王子達に任せる。\nどんな結果になっても、操られ、父様の: …So I'll leave the decision to you, Prince. No matter the outcome, it's better than being manipulated and having Father's pride and dignity trampled on—
m920091.……ちっ！ あのヤロー、次に会ったら\n絶対にぶっ飛ばしてやっからな！！: …Damn! Next time I see that guy, I'll definitely blow him to pieces!!
m920091.……どうした、はよこんか。\nそうじゃ、お主の好きなバナナもあるぞ。: …What's the matter? Come on, hurry up. Here, there's even a banana you like.
m920091.……へぇ、そういうものなんだ。\n私の幼馴染達は、皆乗れたから。\n普通はそうな:
…Huh, is that how it works?
All my childhood friends could ride them, so I always thought that's normal.
m920091.……まさか船酔いされてしまうとは。\n雲に乗ってる方が揺れそうなものですが。: …I never thought you'd get seasick. Riding on clouds would probably be less shaky.
m920091.……みんな、サハギンだけじゃなくて\n雷にも注意が必要かも。気を付けて。: Everyone, we need to watch out not just for sahagin but also for lightning. Stay alert.
m920091.……やはり、こうして共にいるのは\n納得できませんか。: …So, being together like this still feels… unsatisfying, doesn't it?
m920091.……ファー、やはり君は血の気が多すぎる。\n僅かに残る邪気の影響か、元々の性格な: …Far, you're still far too hot-blooded. I can't tell if it's the lingering evil aura or just your nature.
m920091.……ファーが出会ったのが君達で、本当に良かった。\nそれじゃ、ぼくは行くとするよ: …I'm really glad you met Far. Well then, I'm off. Far, don't cause them too much trouble.
m920091.……ファーさんは大事な仲間、\n守るのは当然の事です。その程度の事でしたら、\n: …Far is an important comrade; protecting him is only natural. It's not something that requires a request.
m920091.……一度、落ち着ける場所へと\n移動しましょうか。王子、お疲れ様です。: …Shall we move to a place where we can settle down? Prince, thank you for your efforts.
m920091.……一息つくにはまだ早ぇみたいだな。: …Looks like it's still too early for a breather.
m920091.……一目連？ どこかで聞き覚えが……あぁ、\nキミの古い名前じゃないカ、東天君。: …Ichimokuren? That name sounds familiar… Ah, that's your old name, Yotenkun. How nostalgic— I remember you just after you came under the Great Teacher of the Heavens.
m920091.……嬢ちゃん下がってな。この殺気、\nとても幼馴染に向けるもんとは思えねぇ。\n: …Step back, little lady. This murderous aura doesn't look like something you'd aim at an old friend. You seem eager enough, though.
m920091.……幼馴染とは良いものですね。\nでは、引き続き定風珠の捜索に向かいましょうか。: …Childhood friends are wonderful, aren't they? Then let's continue searching for the Jōfū Jewel.
m920091.……欠片の気配が近づいていると思えば。\nフーコ、それにラミィまで。\nどうして:
…If you think the fragment's aura is drawing nearer—Fuuko, even Ramii—
how could… never mind, it's a question we don't need to ask.
m920091.……死ぬのはそいつが弱かったからに過ぎない。\n弱者にかける情などない……それと: …He died simply because he was weak. I have no pity for the weak… And don't get it twisted—there's no weak yokai like Ichimokuren left.
m920091.……油断なさらぬよう気を付けてください。\nなんせあの風神の娘、\nいつ寝首をか:
…Please stay vigilant.
That Wind-God's daughter could strike without warning.
m920091.……父様のしたことは知ってる。\n人間達にとって許せる事じゃないって事は、\n判: …I know what Father did. I understand it's unforgivable to humans…
m920091.……父様のしたことを思えば、\n斬られたってしょうがないと思ってる。\nでもお願:
…Given what my father did, I figure getting cut down wouldn't matter.
But please, before that, hear me out.
m920091.……王子、久しぶり。\nこの間は、お礼を言えなかったから。\n改めて、お礼を言い: …Prince, long time no see. I couldn't thank you properly last time, so I've come back to express my gratitude properly.
m920091.……相変わらず人の話を聞かないやつだ。\nいいだろう、相手になってやる。\nいつ:
…You still never listen to anyone.
Fine, I'll take you on.
Don't think I'm still the same as I was back then.
m920091.……自分の事ばっかりでごめん。\nでも私、父様をあんな目に遭わせた連中、\n絶対: …Sorry for being selfish. But I'll never forgive those who made my father suffer like that.
m920091.……誰に物を言っている。お前の方こそ、\n吹き飛ばされないよう精々気を付けておく: …Who are you talking to? You'd better watch yourself so you don't get blown away. …Let's go!
m920091.……雷と風、複数の術をああも巧みに操るとは。\n大したものですね。: ……To think you could wield both lightning and wind so deftly, mastering multiple techniques like that. Impressive.
m920091.……！ \n王子、前方に妖怪の群れが見えます。\n至急戦闘のご用意を！:
…! Prince, a horde of monsters is ahead.
Prepare for battle immediately!
m920091.あ、待っ……行っちゃった。\nなんだよぉ、久しぶりに会ったってのにぃ……。: Ah, wait… He's gone. What the heck, we just met after so long…
m920091.あなたたちの下に行くのは\nまた今度になりそう……でも、その時はよろしくねっ！\: Looks like I'll have to visit you later… but when I do, please take care of me! Lepuru-chan will make everyone smile♪
m920091.あなた達が魔物と戦ってるって聞いて、\n私にも何か協力できないかなって、\nず～: I heard you were fighting monsters, so I wondered if I could help. I've been looking for you forever.
m920091.あの傷ではもう助からないな……\n……生かしておけば、\n利用価値もあったんじゃ: With those wounds he won't make it… If we'd kept him alive, he could've been useful.
m920091.ありがとう、私はリェプル。\n気軽にリェプルちゃんって呼んでちょうだい♪: Thanks, I'm Lepuru. Just call me Lepuru-chan, okay♪
m920091.あれは屍解仙！ 何故この地に……いえ、\nそれよりも同胞、美猿王とは……もしや、: That's Shikai-sen! Why is he here… No, more importantly, the “Beautiful Monkey King”… could it be… Far's?
m920091.あれ程大量のエレメンタルが発生するとはの。: I never expected so many elementals to appear at once.
m920091.あ！ あんた達がフーコを取って食おうと！\nそうはさせないんだからなぁー！: Ah! You guys trying to snatch Fuuko and eat her! I won't let that happen!
m920091.いてててて……き、聞いたよフーコ！\nフーコのとーちゃん、邪仙に\n操られてるん: Ouch, ouch, ouch… I-I heard, Fuuko! Your dad's being controlled by the Evil Immortal!?
m920091.うぅ～ん、この辺りの筈なんだけどな～。\nおっかしいなぁ～。: ???: Uuh—this should be around here… weird.
m920091.うん、ありがとう……。\nお願い、お父様……どうか、\nどうか目を覚まして！！: Yeah, thanks… Father, please… please wake up!!
m920091.うん。私とラミィの幼馴染。\nでも、小さい頃修行の旅に出たって聞いて、\nそれっ:
Yeah. He's a childhood friend of mine and Ramii's.
I heard he left on a training journey when we were little, and that's all I knew… Why is he here?
m920091.お待ちくださいユリアンさん、\n鬼門の中を追うのは危険です！\nそれよりも、今は: Please wait, Julian. Chasing into the Demon Gate is dangerous! More importantly, now…
m920091.くぅっ……記憶を失ったと聞いておったが、ここまで\nふ抜けておるとは……えぇいこ: Ugh... I heard you lost your memory, but you're still this clueless... Fine, if you won't come willingly, I'll take you by force! Go, Jiangshi!
m920091.ぐ、ぐぬぅ、ここは一旦退かねばならぬか……ふん、\nだが既にここでの目的は果たし: Guh, damn, we have to retreat for now... Hmph, but our goal here is already accomplished.
m920091.こ、この辺りは……定風珠の欠片の影響で、\nエアーエレメンタルが発生……しやすい: Around here… the fragment's influence makes Air Elementals appear more easily, so watch out…
m920091.ここが……定風珠を……\n隠したどうく……うぷっ。: This is… where they hid the Jōfū Jewel… ugh.
m920091.ここにいるのは華の国の仙人、\n十天君が一人東天君だ。憶えておけ。\n……妖天君: The one here is the Immortal of the Flower Nation, Ten Heaven Lord, and I am the sole East Sky Lord. Remember that. …Yotenkun, let's return.
m920091.ここは英霊の魂が眠る聖なる森。邪な気持ちを抱く\n仙人の好きにさせるわけにはいき: This is the sacred forest where the heroes' souls rest. We can't let a rogue immortal do as they please. Prince, prepare for battle!
m920091.ここ最近、何やら森が騒がしいと思えば。\n英霊達の眠りを妨げているのはお前か。: Lately the forest's been noisy. So you're the one disturbing the heroes' slumber?
m920091.このままじゃ父様……ううん、\n父様だけじゃない、東の国は\n大変な事になっちゃ: If this keeps going, Father… no, not just Father—the Eastern lands will be in serious trouble.
m920091.このままではらちが明かないな。\nおい、ここは一旦退くぞ。: At this rate we'll never settle the score. Hey, let's fall back for now.
m920091.この神仙郷で修行を積めば、その闘争心も\n少しは抑えられ……誰だい、そこにいるの: If you train here in the Divine Immortal Village, maybe that fighting spirit will be tempered… Who's there, who's that over there!
m920091.これは……不思議ですね。この方の歌を\n聴いてると、行動の疲れが半減するような…: That's… strange. Listening to that song seems to cut our fatigue in half… Prince, I think we can get back into battle right away!
m920091.これは嬉しい申し出ですね。リェプルさんの\n先ほどの不思議な歌、何やら疲れが和ら: What a welcome offer. Your mysterious song earlier seems to have a soothing power that eases fatigue. That's very encouraging.
m920091.こんな事頼める立場じゃないのは判ってる……。\nでも、偉大だった父様が、\nあん:
I know I'm not in a position to ask this…
But I can't stand seeing my great father become a puppet of that scoundrel.
m920091.ご忠告ありがとうございます。\n王子、指示をお願いします！:
Thank you for the advice.
Prince, please give us your orders!
m920091.さぁ、此方に来るのだ。我らと共にいれば、\nまたあの頃のように思うまま、気の向く: Come this way. If you stand with us, you can unleash your power just as freely as back in the old days.
m920091.さよう、そやつは我ら邪仙郷の仙人が一人。\n目覚めておるのは知っておったが、よも: Indeed, that one is a hermit of our Evil Immortal Village. I knew he'd awaken, but never expected him to be working with you…
m920091.す、すみません……ギガースが誰かと\n話してるのが聞こえ、\n雪道を急いできたも: I-I'm sorry… I heard Gigars talking to someone, so I hurried over the snowy path.
m920091.そいつぁいい、一気に大量ゲットじゃねーか。: That's great—looks like we can snag a massive haul in one go.
m920091.そういえば、此処はキミの故郷だったネェ。\nもしかして、あの娘は知り合いかイ？: Now that I think of it, this was your hometown, wasn't it? Could that girl be an acquaintance?
m920091.そうだ！ 修行の旅に出てたんでしょ！\n折角だし、王子達と戦ってみたら！！\n王:
That's right! You went off on a training trip, didn't you?
Since you're here, why not fight the Prince and his crew!!
They're incredibly strong!
m920091.そこで倒れている風神の娘だ。\n……ただの古い顔馴染みに過ぎない。\n今の俺には: That's the Wind God's daughter lying there. Just an old familiar face. She means nothing to me now.
m920091.そっかぁ……うん、そーだね！\nよーっし、わたし達も引き続き欠片を探そっか！\n: I see… Yeah, that's right! All right, let's keep searching for fragments too! Let's give it our all!
m920091.その前に、念の為確認しておくけどよ。\n風神を弱めてどうすんだ。\nぶったぎっち: Before that, just to be clear—what do we do once we weaken the Wind God? Can we just smash him to bits?
m920091.それでは王子、戻りましょうか。: Well then, Prince, shall we return?
m920091.それに、みすみす風神を奪われてしまうなんて。\n華の国で強者として名を馳せた、\: And to think we lost the Wind God right before our eyes. The so-called strong ones from the Land of Flowers, you really aren't acting like yourselves, Yotenkun.
m920091.そんなこと、まるで頭にない様子だった。\n何度呼びかけても、私の声なんて\n全く: But he seems completely oblivious. No matter how many times I call out, he doesn't hear my voice at all…
m920091.だが、ここにいた事を知られては厄介だ。\n念の為、叩き潰しておくとしよう。: But it'd be troublesome if they found out we were here. Just in case, let's crush them.
m920091.ちっ！ 風神の野郎、\n完全に我を忘れてやがる！\nあの傷でまだ動けんのかよ！: Damn! That Wind God… completely lost his mind! Can he even move with that wound?
m920091.ちょっとちょっとぉ、不思議な歌なんてやめてよ！\nさっきのはハッスルソングって言: Hey, hey, stop calling it a mysterious song! It's a hustle song! It's my proper special skill!
m920091.ちょっと人探しをしてたんだけど……って、\nあぁ～～～っ！ もしかして、\nあな: I was looking for someone… Ahhh! Could it be you, Prince's army!?
m920091.で、でもぉ……う～ん、\nフーコがそう言うなら……\n……あ、そうだ！ これ！: Well, but… hmm, if Fuuko says so… Oh, right! This!
m920091.どうやら吸魂の力を使えるようだが、英霊の魂は\nお前のような者が好きにして良いも: It seems you can use soul-sucking power, but a hero's soul isn't something someone like you can just toy with. Return the souls and leave at once!
m920091.どうやら早速現れたようですね。: It seems it has appeared right away.
m920091.はい、その際には是非リェプルさんの歌で\n皆を盛り上げていただければと思います。: Yes, when that time comes, I'd love for you to lift everyone's spirits with your song.
m920091.はい、フーコさんの為にも、\n一刻も早く欠片を集めねばなりませんね。\n引き続き:
Yes, for Fuuko's sake we must gather the fragments as quickly as possible.
Let's continue searching the area.
m920091.はい、期待していますね、ファーさん。\n王子も何かとお疲れでしょう、ひとまずは戻: Yes, I'm counting on you, Far. Prince, you must be exhausted—return for now and get some rest. Good work.
m920091.まぁいいカ。キミの『風コウ陣』の力も\n弱まってしまったようだし。\nボクも手伝: Well, never mind. It seems your “Wind-Kou Formation” has weakened, so I guess I'll have to lend a hand.
m920091.まぁ慣れない乗り物じゃしょうがないですよ。\nそれよりも、早く定風珠の欠片を探し: Well, it's bound to be rough in an unfamiliar vehicle. Anyway, let's find those Jōfū fragments quickly!
m920091.まさか海を渡る必要があるとは。\n随分と遠くに、定風珠を隠されたのですね。:
I never imagined we'd have to cross the sea.
You hid the Teifūju far out there, didn't you?
m920091.また何かありましたら呼んでください。\nいつでも駆け付けますので。: If anything else comes up, just call. I'll be there in a flash.
m920091.もぅ、どこにいるのよ「王子」とかいう人は！\nこのままじゃ私、\n遭難しちゃい「: ???: Geez, where the heck is that “Prince” guy! If this keeps up, I'll get lost…
m920091.もぉ、そんなんじゃあなた達の方が\n危ないじゃない……そうだっ！\nそ～れ、ハッ: Geez, that makes you the ones in danger… that's it! Here, hustle hustle~♪
m920091.もしかして、フーコの為に\n欠片を集めてくれてたんじゃ！: Maybe he's been gathering fragments for you, Fuuko!
m920091.もちろん、皆に感謝してるのは本当。\n皆の為なら、なんだって協力するから。: Of course I'm truly grateful to all of you. I'll help with anything for your sake.
m920091.わーってるよ！ ……ったくお前はオレの保護者かっての。\nけどま、大事な仲間……: Got it! …Geez, are you trying to be my guardian or what? But hey, an important comrade… not a bad sound. Don't worry, I'll blast the entire Evil Immortal Village myself!
m920091.イロハさん、サイゾウさん、お二人の気持ちは分かります。\nですが、まずは彼女のお:
Iroha, Saizou, I understand how you feel.
But why don't we at least listen to her story? If it concerns the nation, we can't just ignore it.
m920091.ウ……グゥッ！！ …………こ……ここは\n……いや……そうか……ワシは、\n奴に: …Ugh…! …Here… this… No… I see… I… was…
m920091.エアーエレメンタルは周囲を切り裂く風を纏っている。\nそれに、奴らの実体を捕まえ:
The Air Elementals are cloaked in wind that slashes everything around them.
And catching their physical forms is nearly impossible.
m920091.エアーエレメンタル？ ……ダメですね、\n完全に伸びてしまっています。: Air Elementals? …That's bad, they're completely out of control.
m920091.エレメンタルとは珍しいのう。害意があるものでもないし、\n本来そっとしておくべき: Elementals are a rare sight. They're not malicious, and normally you'd leave them be, but if we're after the Jōfū fragments, ignoring them'll be difficult.
m920091.カッカッカ！ やはり隠れても無駄か。\nまさかここで貴様等に出会うとはのう。\n: Shikai-sen! Kakkakaka! Hiding was useless after all. Who would have thought we'd meet you here. Taoist Nataku, and our comrade the “Beautiful Monkey King”!
m920091.シノさんとの約束で、私達妖怪は、\n人間達に無暗に手を出さない事に\nなっていた: By my promise with Shino, we youkai agreed not to attack humans recklessly.
m920091.フーコさん、一目連さんは本気のようです。\n王子、戦闘のご用意を！: Fuuko, Ichimokuren looks serious. Prince, prepare for battle!
m920091.フーコさん、我々が風神の動きを\n止めますので、早く！: Fuuko, we'll stop the Wind God's movements, so hurry!
m920091.フーコさんは、人との接触等は\n余りなかったのですか？ 話を聞いてる限り、\n少:
Fuuko, have you had little contact with people?
From what I hear, you seem a bit out of touch with the world.
m920091.ホホッ！ 流石は歴戦の戦士達の眠る地。\n上質な魂ばかりで目移りしちゃうヨ。: Hoho! As expected of a place where veteran warriors sleep. So many fine souls, it's hard to pick just one.
m920091.ボクにとっては魂だけの方が利用しやすいからネェ。\nキミが風神の力を使う為、生か: A soul alone is easier for me to use. I only kept you alive so you could wield the Wind God's power. If I can't use you, I'll just kill you as originally planned.
m920091.ボクの落魂陣なら魂の操作は自由自在。\n魂の欠片でもあれば現身を与える事も出来る: With my Falling Soul Formation I can manipulate souls at will. Even a fragment can be given a physical form. Well, as a puppet of mine, of course! Hoho!
m920091.リェプルさんのお陰で元気が湧いてきましたね。\nこの調子で、今後も頑張りましょう: Thanks to you, Lepuru, we're feeling revitalized. Let's keep it up! Prince, great job today!
m920091.一ヵ所に欠片が集まっているなど、\n偶然とは思えませんが……もしや、我々以外にも:
It's hard to believe all the fragments would gather in one spot by chance…
Could there be someone else besides us collecting them?
m920091.一人で人間の所に行ったって聞いて、\n急いで追いかけて来たのに……もし\n取って: I heard you went to the humans alone, so I rushed after you… If you get taken and eaten, what am I supposed to do—!
m920091.一目連……どうしてそんな奴と……。: Ichimokuren… why are you with someone like that…?
m920091.一目連？ ……もしかして、\n父様を助けに来てくれたの？: Ichimokuren? …Did you come to help Father?
m920091.人の子らよ、すまないが\nぼくの頼みを聞いてはくれないか。: Children, I'm sorry, but could you do me a favor?
m920091.人間どころか、ほとんどの種の者は\n雲になんて乗れませんよ。: Not just humans—most species can't ride clouds at all.
m920091.仙人達がやすやすと手に落ちるとも思いにくい。\nきっと、何か汚い罠にでもはめられ: It's hard to believe the immortals would fall so easily. They must've been caught in some dirty trap. That's why I judged the chase to be dangerous.
m920091.何かあったらいつでも呼んで。\nこれからよろしくね、王子。: If anything comes up, just call me anytime. From now on, please take care of me, Prince.
m920091.何かご用事があったのでしょう。\n一目連さんも欠片を集めてる様子でしたし、\nき: He must have had some business to attend to. Ichimokuren seemed to be gathering fragments, so he'll surely come back soon.
m920091.俺の宝貝『風コウ陣』は風神の力で強化されている。\n悪いが力の加減は出来そうにも: My prized “Wind Formation” is powered by the Wind God's strength. Sorry, but I can't dial the power down. Give it everything you've got… or you won't just get hurt, you'll be finished.
m920091.再び邪仙がファーを狙わないとも限らない。\nどうかファーを守ってやってはくれない: We can't be sure the Evil Immortals won't target Far again. Could you protect Far for us? As you heard, Far was originally an Evil Immortal, but with you guys…
m920091.凄い……昔は、私達三人の中じゃ\n一番力を使うのが苦手だったのに……。: Amazing… Back then, I was the worst at using power among the three of us…
m920091.厄介じゃったこの地の連中も、既に我らの手中。\n最後に笑うのは、我ら邪仙郷よ！: Those troublesome locals are already in our grasp. In the end, we, the Evil Immortals, will be the ones laughing! Ka-ka-ka! Well then, farewell!
m920091.可能性はありそうですね。\n……しかし、今はそれよりも\n優先すべき事がありそう:
That seems plausible.
…But for now, there's something more urgent we need to handle.
m920091.吸魂の力？ ……あぁ、魂の真似事が出来る\n児戯みたいな術の事かい。ボクの宝貝『: Soul-sucking power? …Ah, you mean that childish trick that mimics souls. Don't lump my prized “Falling Soul Formation” together with such a petty technique.
m920091.大事な幼馴染の為だもん！\nこれくらい任せてよっ！: It's for my precious childhood friend! Leave this to me!
m920091.奴が持ってたのは定風珠の欠片のほんの一部。\nもし、欠片を集めて父様の力を増大さ:
He only had a tiny piece of a Teifūju fragment.
If we gather the fragments and amplify my father's power, the Eastern lands will be in grave danger.
m920091.奴らの手から、父様を解放してくれてありがとう。\nそれと、行く当てのなくなった私: Thank you for freeing my father from those monsters' hands. And also… thank you for taking me, who had nowhere to go, into your group.
m920091.嬢ちゃんの前で話す事じゃないかもな。\nけどよ、ハッキリさせておかねーと、\nい: Maybe it's not the kind of thing to say in front of the lady, but if we don't make it clear now, we won't know what to do when the time comes.
m920091.定風珠の欠片……探して来てくれたんだ。\nありがと、ラミィ。: You found a fragment of the Jōfū Jewel… Thanks, Ramii.
m920091.定風珠の欠片の力か……興味深いものだ。: It must be the power of the Jōfū fragment… fascinating.
m920091.定風珠は風を操る事が出来る宝具、\n風神である父様には天敵とも言える宝具。: The Teifūju is a Noble Phantasm that can command wind—a natural enemy of my father, the Wind God.
m920091.宝具は父様には扱えないから、\nずっと昔に破壊して、隠したって言ってた。\nまさ:
Since my father can't wield that Noble Phantasm, he supposedly destroyed and sealed it ages ago.
I never imagined anyone would find its fragments…
m920091.実は今、東の国では父様……\n風神が暴れて大変な事になってるの。: Actually, over in the Eastern lands, my father… the Wind God is rampaging and it's a disaster.
m920091.彼女は風神ではない。\n頭では判っているのです。\nですが、そう簡単に割り切れる:
She isn't the Wind God. I know that intellectually.
But it's not that easy to just cut it off…
m920091.待てファー、追うのは危険だ。\nそれも奴の策かもしれない。: Hold it, Far. Chasing them is dangerous. It might even be part of his plan.
m920091.接近して捕らえて倒すのは難しいじゃろうな。\n遠距離から核を撃ち抜き倒すのが賢明:
Getting close enough to capture and defeat them will be tough.
It's wiser to strike them down from a distance with a nuclear shot.
m920091.改めて自己紹介しておくね。\n私は風神の娘、フーコ。\n話を聞いてくれてありがと:
Let me reintroduce myself.
I'm the Wind God's daughter, Fuuko.
Thanks for listening.
m920091.普段の父様だったら、あんな奴に操られる訳がない。\n奴から感じた気配……多分、定:
My father would never be manipulated by someone like that.
The aura I sensed from him… I think he used the power of a Teifūju to weaken my father and control him.
m920091.暴れてる父様の隣にいた奴、妖天君？ とか名乗ってた。\n風神は華の国の十天君のも:
The guy standing next to my rampaging father called himself “You-ten-kun” or something.
He shouted that the Wind God belongs to the Ten-kun of the Flower Nation!
I think he's being controlled by that guy.
m920091.東の国が……なにやら不穏な話のようですね。: The Eastern lands… sounds like a rather ominous matter.
m920091.東の国を手に入れるのは、通天教主様のご命令。\n手をぬいたりはしないでくれヨ？: Taking the Eastern lands is the High Priest's command. Don't back out now, okay? I'll live up to the name “East” that the High Priest bestowed on me.
m920091.東の国を救う為でもあります。\n協力は惜しみませんよ。:
It's also to save the Eastern lands.
We won't hold back our help.
m920091.殺意はなかったようだが、\n雲に乗り、風を吹き出す風袋。\nお主、もしや……。: There was no murderous intent, but the wind-bag that rides the clouds and blows the wind… you, could it be…?
m920091.父様の思う所は判らない……でも、\nあんな奴らの良いようにされるよりは、\n良か: I don't understand what my father would think… but I'd rather this than being used by those scum… that seems better.
m920091.父様は昔から人間を嫌ってたから。万が一にも\n人との接触がないよう、屋敷から出る:
My father has hated humans forever.
He practically banned me from leaving the mansion so I'd never meet anyone…
m920091.父様を止めるのは、きっと東の国を救う事にもつながる筈。\n私に出来る事なら、何で:
Stopping him should also save the Eastern lands.
I'll do anything I can.
…Please lend me your strength, Prince.
m920091.王子、仙人達がこの地の支配を目論んでる以上、\n彼女を一人にしておくのは危険では: Prince, since the immortals are plotting to claim this land, isn't it risky to leave her alone? We should think about her future.
m920091.王子、先ほど倒した妖怪達が\n欠片を落としていきましたよ！: Prince, the monsters we just defeated dropped fragments!
m920091.王子、前方に人影が！\n妖天君……ではないようですね。:
Prince, there's a figure up ahead!
It doesn't look like Lord Yōten, though.
m920091.王子、妖怪の群れとは少し距離があるようです。\n僅かな時間とはなりますが、次の戦: Prince, the youkai horde is still a bit far off. You'll have a short window, so please rest and ready yourself for the next fight.
m920091.王子、屍解仙の好きにさせる訳には参りません。\n戦闘のご指示をお願いします！！: Prince, we can't just let Shikai-sen do as he pleases. Please give us battle instructions!!
m920091.王子、戦闘のご指示をお願いします！！: Prince, please give us your battle orders!!
m920091.皆と一緒にいる事は、父様が望む事じゃないかも\nしれない。でも私は、助けてくれた: Being with everyone might not be what my father wanted, but I want to stay with the people who saved me. And I have to atone for what my father did…
m920091.皆のお陰で助かった。\nこれでまた、英霊達の魂も\n静かに眠る事が出来るはずだ。: Thanks to all of you we were saved. Now the heroes' souls can finally rest in peace.
m920091.礼には及びませんよ。\nここは戦いで散った者の魂を尊ぶ大切な地。\nあのような者: No need for thanks. This is a hallowed ground that honors the souls fallen in battle. We can't just let someone like that run wild.
m920091.神仙郷が奴らの手に落ちるとは……。\nファーの邪気を取り払おうと思ったが、\n今: The Sacred Immortal Village falling into their hands… I tried to cleanse Far's evil aura, but now doesn't seem the right time.
m920091.私の商売道具、どこかに\n忘れてきちゃったみたい。\nごめんなさい、急いで取りに: I think I left my trade tools somewhere… I'm sorry, I have to rush back and get them.
m920091.私達にとっては海なんて関係ないから。\n雲に乗れないだなんて、人間って不便だね。:
The sea means nothing to us.
Humans being unable to ride clouds—how inconvenient.

m920142.そうそう！\n街で変なのに絡まれた時とか助けてくれたしね！\nすっごい頼れる助手: That's right! She even helped me when some weirdos cornered me in town! She's a really dependable assistant~!
m920142.そうですね。\nこのまま渓谷の奥へ進みましょう。:
I suppose so.
Let's head deeper into the valley.
m920142.そうですね。それでは王子、\n私達も王国へ帰還しましょうか。\n此度の遠征、お疲: That's right. Well then, Prince, shall we all return to the kingdom? Thanks for your hard work on this expedition!
m920142.そうならないために、私達が捜査をしているんだろう？\nだが、幸い助手殿はすぐに見: That's why we're investigating, isn't it? But luckily, it seems the assistant will be found soon. The traces of battle lead that way.
m920142.そうね、これ以上は分が悪いわ。\n――ニコル！ アナタの技術は惜しいけれど、\n:
I suppose so; the odds are against us from here on.
―Nicole! Your skills are a pity,
but I won't forget the glimpse of your talent!
m920142.そう！ あのニコルちゃんだよー♪\n――ってふざけてる場合じゃないの！\nあの欠:
That's right! It's your Nicole-chan~♪
――But now isn't the time for jokes!
The monsters holding those shards are dangerous!!
m920142.そこまで！ 模擬戦終了です！: That's enough! The sparring match is over!
m920142.そのためにも、情報収集がかかせないな。\nよし、お前はこの石を作っただろう研究者:
To that end, we need to gather more intelligence.
Very well, you will infiltrate the workshop of the researcher
who created this stone.
m920142.そのとおりです。ニコルさんの護衛は任せましたよ？\n――我が主、ゴブリンには爆薬:
You're right. I'll leave Nicole's protection to you.
――My lord, there is one among the Goblins carrying explosives.
Please command with caution so that our rear guard isn't caught in the blast!
m920142.それでは、負傷した兵の手当を終えたら、\n鉱脈へ向けて出発しましょうか。\nニコ:
Then, once we've finished tending to the wounded soldiers,
let's set out for the vein.
Nicole, please lead the way.
m920142.それでは王子、\nあちらの砦でニコルさんの話を聞きましょうか。\n大事件にならな: Then, Prince, shall we head to that fortress and hear Nicole-san's tale? I hope it doesn't turn into a huge incident…
m920142.それでは王子、我々は周辺を警戒しつつ、\n王国へ戻りましょうか。: Then, Prince, let's keep watch on the surroundings and head back to the kingdom.
m920142.そんなに頭が回るゴブリンが相手なら、\n助手ちゃんの身がますます心配になってきた:
If we're dealing with a Goblin that clever,
I'm even more worried about my assistant……
m920142.そんな王子さまと一緒に欠片を取り戻したらさ、\n目の前で実力を見せたことにならな:
If we get the fragment back with the Prince by our side,
wouldn't that prove my strength to everyone?
I mean, Nicole-chan thinks so, right?
m920142.そんな風習が出来たのは、\n王国が私たち元魔王軍との戦いの中で、\n絆を紡いでき:
Perhaps that custom arose because the kingdom
has built bonds through its battles with us, the former Demon Army.
m920142.ただでさえ俊敏な騎兵が、より打たれ強くなるとは。\n王子、あのゴブリンライダーに:
An already agile cavalry unit becoming even more durable……
Prince, please be careful with that Goblin Rider.
m920142.たどっていけば、合流できそうですね。\n王子、このまま追跡を続けましょう！: If we follow them, we should catch up. Prince, let's keep tracking!
m920142.だ、だって、よわよわ王子とお姉ちゃんに、\n一人前になったところを見てもらうんだ:
W-Well, I have to show my weakling Prince and big sister
that I'm finally a full-fledged warrior!
I can't afford to lose here!
m920142.だからね、ありがとう、ハルモニアお姉ちゃん。\nこれからも、よろしくね？:
So, thank you, Harmonia-neesan.
I'm looking forward to working with you from now on, okay?
m920142.だが、我々が世界的大企業となったあかつきには、\n必ずお前をもう一度スカウトしに:
But once we become a global corporation,
we'll definitely come to scout you again.
I hope you'll give it some thought then.
m920142.だが！ 汚いエルフの連中が、\n同じ手段に出ないとも限らない！\nこれは今すぐ侵:
But! We can't rule out the possibility
that those filthy elves will resort to the same tactics!
We must launch the invasion immediately――
m920142.ちっ、裏切り者がぬけぬけと！\n貴様にはダークエルフの誇りがないのか！:
Tch, you ungrateful traitor!
Have you no pride as a Dark Elf?!
m920142.でも助手ちゃん！\nこっちに来る部隊を全部返り討ちにしてくれてるよ！\nうぅ～、:
But Assistant-chan!
You've been turning back every single unit that comes at us!
Uu~ You really are such a help!
m920142.ところでところで、相談なんだけど……。: Oh, by the way, by the way, I have something to discuss…….
m920142.とっこっろっでー。\nね、王子さま？ そして助手ちゃんのお姉さん？\n助手ちゃん:
Whoosh~♪
Well, Prince? And the assistant's big sister?
Did you two get a good look at how she performed?
m920142.とはいえ、欠片を持つ魔物は要注意ね。\nこれくらいなら、どうということはないけれ: Still, we need to be wary of monsters carrying fragments. This much is no trouble, but――
m920142.ともあれ、ご無事で何よりです。\n……ところで、先程気になることを\n仰っていま:
In any case, I'm glad you're safe.
……By the way, didn't you mention something concerning earlier?
m920142.どうにか魔物の群れを排除できましたね。\n助手さんが逃げたのは、渓谷のさらに奥で:
We've managed to clear the horde of monsters.
It seems the assistant fled even deeper into the valley.
m920142.どちらも準備は良さそうですね。\nそれでは王子、どうか全力で！\n模擬戦――開始:
You both seem ready.
Then, Prince, please give it your all!
Sparring match—begin!!
m920142.な、なるほど……？\n王子、『賢者の金赤石』の欠片を持つ魔物には、\n十分に注意: I-I see…? Prince, please handle any monster carrying a fragment of the “Sage's Crimson Stone” with great caution!
m920142.なぁに、取り戻せば全部問題なしだよ！\n知ってる？ 王子さま達めちゃくちゃ強いん:
Don't worry, we'll get it back and everything will be fine!
You know? The Prince and his friends are super strong!
m920142.なっ……貴様は妖精郷の……！\nまさか我々を監視していたというのか！？:
Wha... You're from the Fairyland...!
You've been spying on us, haven't you?!
m920142.なるほど、『賢者の金赤石』の件で、\nニコルさんが襲撃される可能性は残っています:
I see. Given the situation with the “Sage's Gold-Red Stone,\"
there is still a risk that Nicole might be attacked.
m920142.なるほど、ゴブリン達は\nニコルさんの実験が成功間近だと知っていて\n待ち構えて:
I see. Perhaps the Goblins knew
that Nicole's experiment was on the verge of success
and were lying in wait……
m920142.なるほど、確かに秘められた力を感じる。\nこれならば妖精郷に攻め入る足がかりにな:
I see. I can certainly feel a hidden power within it.
This might just be the foothold we need to invade the Fairyland.
m920142.はぁ……でも助手ちゃんが無事でほんとに良かった。\nほらこっちおいで、ぎゅーって:
Phew…… I'm so glad Assistant-chan is safe.
Come here, let me give you a big hug!
m920142.はぁ……はぁ……。\nゴブリンってどこまでもしつこ～い！！:
Haa…… haa…….
Goblins are just so, so persistent!!
m920142.はぁ……はぁ……。\n何とかなったよぉ……。\nニコルちゃん先生、怪我はなかった:
Haa…… haa…….
We made it in the end…….
Professor Nicole-chan, are you hurt?
m920142.ふふ、こちらこそ。\n頼りない姉貴分かもしれませんが、\nこれからも一緒に歩んで:
Hehe, thank you as well.
I may be an unreliable big sister,
but let's continue walking this path together.
m920142.ふふ、でもきっと、すぐに戻ってきますよ。\nきっと何か、やり残したことがあるので:
Hehe, but she'll surely be back soon.
She must have something she forgot to do.
m920142.ふふっ、あいつも先祖に似たのだろうな。\nさぁ、そろそろ件の王子たちが到着するぞ:
Hehe, he's probably just like his ancestors.
Well, it looks like those princes are arriving soon.
m920142.ふふっ、王子のことですから、\nきっとニコルさんが言い出さなくても、\nご自身で:
Fufu, well, given how you are,
I'm sure you would have recruited her yourself
even if she hadn't brought it up.
m920142.ふふん、そのとおり！ 何を隠そう私こそ、\n『賢者の金赤石』の精製に成功した錬金:
Heh, you got it! As it happens, I'm the alchemist
who successfully refined the “Sage's Aurumite,”
Nicole-chan――though I can't really brag about it right now…….
m920142.ふむふむ……研究のお手伝いかぁ、楽しそうかも！\nそれじゃあいってきまーす♪:
Mm-hmm... helping with research, huh? Sounds fun!
I'll be on my way then~♪
m920142.まさか本当に助けに来てくれる人がいるなんて。\nしかもそれがあの王国軍だったなん:
I can't believe someone actually came to help me.
And that someone was the Royal Army, of all things!
Yay! Thank you so much!!
m920142.むっ……ボクだってぎゅーってしたいです！\nあなたには渡しませんからっ！！:
Hmph…… I want a hug too!
I'm not letting you have all the fun!!
m920142.むむっ……。\nま、まったく、そういう話は後にしてください！\nこれから戦闘が始:
Mmph…….
Mm, quite enough of that! Let's save that talk for later!
A battle is about to begin, after all!
m920142.もう少しだけ、自分の商才というものを信じて、\n新たなビジネスに挑むとしよう！:
I'll have a bit more faith in my business acumen
and take on this new venture!
m920142.もう持ってないってばー！！\nばかっ、ばかばかっ！ ばかゴブリン～！！: I don't have it anymore~!! Idiot, idiot idiot! Stupid goblin~!!
m920142.やっ……こ、こないで！ お姉ちゃん、\nエフネちゃん、よわよわ王子ぃ！ 助け――:
D-don't…… come closer! Sis,
Eithne, weakling Prince! Help――
m920142.やーい、よわよわへなちょこゴブリン～！\n魔界でも物質界でも最弱のごっぶり～ん！: Boo-hoo, weak and pathetic goblins~! The weakest goblins in the Demon World or the Material World~!
m920142.よ、よわよわ王子……？\nこれまで、迷惑ばかりかけてごめんなさい。:
T-the wimpy Prince…?
I'm sorry for causing you so much trouble.
m920142.よぉし！ その意気だ！\n雇用主として嬉しいよ助手ちゃん！！:
Yes! That's the spirit!
I'm so happy as your employer, Assistant-chan!!
m920142.よし、ではお前はデーモン達の指揮をとれ！\n我々はこの欠片の力を観測するぞ！:
Very well, you take command of the Demons!
We will observe the power of these fragments!
m920142.よし、もう一度ゼロから何を出来るか考えるぞ！！: Right, let's start from scratch and think about what we can do!!
m920142.わ、わわ……う、うん！\n大切な友達を、ゴブリンに渡したりしないんだから！:
Y-yes…… y-yeah!
I'm not letting the Goblins take my precious friend!
m920142.わ、分かった！ 助手ちゃん！\n後ろに下がるよ！ はやくはやく！！:
Y-yes, I get it! Assistant-chan!
Retreat! Let's go, let's go!!
m920142.わぁー！！ 持ってない！ もう持ってないからー！！\n宝石割れちゃうし、助手ちゃ:
??? : Waaah!! I don't have it! I don't have it anymore!!
My gem broke, my assistant is missing,
I'm being chased by monsters, I'm just so unlucky!!
m920142.わっ、この反応……間違いない！\n気をつけて、今現れたゴブリンは、\n『賢者の金:
Oh, that reaction…… I'm sure of it!
Be careful. The goblins that just appeared
must be carrying shards of the “Sage's Aurumite”!
m920142.んー……どこにいるかは分からないけど、\n鉱脈が見つかっちゃうのも時間の問題かな:
Hmm…… I don't know exactly where it is, but
finding the vein should only be a matter of time…….
m920142.アナタの技術力は高く評価しているけれど、\n軍略についてはまだまだのようね、ゴブ:
I highly regard your technical skills,
but your military strategy still leaves a lot to be desired, Goblin Doctor.
m920142.ウフフッ、久しぶりねぇ。\nさぁ博士『賢者の金赤石』採掘進捗を報告なさい。:
Uhuhu, it's been a while, hasn't it?
Now then, Doctor, report on the progress of the “Sage's Gold-Red Stone” excavation.
m920142.ウフフフッ、また強くなったんじゃないかしら？\n魔王様を倒したのは、やはり偶然で:
Uhuhuhu, you've gotten even stronger, haven't you?
It seems defeating the Demon Lord wasn't a fluke after all.
m920142.ウフフフッ、気にする必要はないわ。\nさぁ、かかってきなさい。\nゴブリン族の技:
Uhuhuhu, don't worry about it.
Now then, come at me.
I'll show you the true might of Goblin technology and strategy!
m920142.ギャギャ！ カケラ！ ヨコセ！！: Gya gya! Fragment! Give it here!!
m920142.ギャギャ！！ アシドメ！ アシドメ！！: Gya gya!! Hold him back! Hold him back!!
m920142.クソッ、撤退しろ！\nここで戦力を失うことは許さん！:
Dammit, fall back!
We can't afford to lose strength here!
m920142.コノ地域に鉱脈があるノハ確実。\n後は欠片の実験ト並行シ、\n人海戦術で調査すれ:
There is definitely a vein in this region.
Once the fragment experiments are underway,
we can survey the area with a human wave tactic!
m920142.シカシ、単純に採掘するだけでハ、\n本来の力を発揮させることはできマイ……。\n:
However, simply mining it, ha,
won't unleash its true power, mai…….
I still need to capture that alchemist, shika――
m920142.スピカ！ ひとりで深追いはだめですよ！\n地の利はあちらにあります！:
Spica! Don't chase them too far on your own!
They have the advantage of the terrain!
m920142.ズルくて結構！ ココで捕まるわけにはいかないノダ！\nメカゴブリンクイーン様のタ:
Unfair is fine! I can't afford to be captured here!
For the sake of Mech Goblin Queen!
For the advancement of Goblin science!!
m920142.ダガ！ これより先の人生ハ、\nゴブリン族と、メカゴブリンクイーン様のためニ\n:
But! From this point on, your life, ha,
will be spent using your abilities for the Goblin tribe
and for Mech Goblin Queen-sama……!!
m920142.ダガ！ そろそろ観念シ、\n欠片をこちらへ渡すがヨイ！！\nさらに鉱脈の在り処も: Daga! It's time you accepted reality! Hand over the fragment to us!! And tell us where the vein is, too!!
m920142.チョコのかさ増しなんてしようとするからだよぅ……。\nで、でも次の事業の計画はあ:
It's all because you tried to bulk up the chocolate with fillers…….
B-But you have a plan for the next venture, right!?
m920142.ニコルさん、でしたか？\n良ければ詳しい話を聞かせてもらえないでしょうか？:
Ms. Nicole, was it?
Would you mind telling us more about what happened?
m920142.ニコルさん、助手さんの\n居場所に心当たりはありませんか？:
Nicole, do you have any idea
where your assistant might be?
m920142.ニコルちゃん先生～！\n狙われてるって分かってて前に出ちゃだめだよー！？:
Nicole-sensei~!
You can't just charge out there knowing you're being targeted, okay!?
m920142.ハッ！ 鉱脈までは発見いたしましタ。\nシカシ王子タチの妨害にあイ……。:
Hah! We've located the vein!
But the Prince and his party interfered, so……
m920142.ハハハッ！ それは約束できないぞ！\n経営者とは社員と利益のためには悪にもなるの:
Hahaha! I can't promise that!
A manager will do evil things if it's for the sake of his employees and profits!
m920142.メカゴブリンクイーン様が\n視察に来るのはもう少し後ダガ、\n先に採掘作業を始め:
Mech Goblin Queen-sama
will come to inspect things a bit later, da ga,
let's get the mining started in the meantime, u.
m920142.メカゴブリンクイーン様！\n撤退いたしまス！ 早くこちらヘ！！:
Mecha Goblin Queen!
We're retreating! Come this way, quickly!!
m920142.モウ追いついてきたノカ！\n仕方ナイ、欠片の実験成果を見せてやろウ！\nゴブリン:
They've caught up to us already!
Fine, I'll show you the results of my fragment experiments!
Goblin Rider, show them your even greater power!
m920142.ユージェン、裏切り者って言われてますよ？: Yuugen, he's calling you a traitor, you know?
m920142.事業を起こすにも資金がいるのだ。\nつまり金を稼ぐための仕事を、始めるための金が:
Starting a business requires capital.
In other words, we don't have the money to start the work of making money!
m920142.仕入れ……？\nこ、この赤い宝石の欠片はいったい！？:
Stocked up……?
W-What on earth are these red gem fragments!?
m920142.以前は断られてしまいましたが、今度は共に――: I was turned down before, but this time, together we—
m920142.仲間の歓迎会が模擬戦だなんて、\n王国も変な風習があるものですよね。:
A welcoming party that's a sparring match…
The kingdom certainly has some odd customs.
m920142.先程、魔物が所持していたものが、\n『賢者の金赤石』の欠片でしたっけ。:
Just now, you mentioned that what the monster was carrying
was a fragment of the 'Philosopher's Red Stone,' correct?
m920142.分かりました。助手さんの身が心配です。\n王子、急ぎその場所へ向かいましょう！:
Understood. I'm worried about your assistant.
Prince, let's head to that location immediately!
m920142.前は逃げ出しちゃったけど、\n今度は……、\nあ、あたしも、王子たちについて行っ:
I ran away before,
but this time…
Ah, can I… can I go with the princes this time?
m920142.助手さんが無事で何よりです。\nあとは欠片の奪取が、残された課題ですね……。:
I'm relieved that the assistant is safe.
Now, the remaining task is to retrieve the fragment…….
m920142.助手ちゃぁぁぁぁん！ 良かった！\n無事で良かったよぉぉぉっ！ うわぁぁぁん！！:
Assistaaaant! Thank goodness!
I'm so glad you're okay! Waaah!!
m920142.助手ちゃんでも白馬の王子様でもいいから！\n誰かニコルちゃんを助けてよぉ～！？:
Whether it's my assistant or a prince on a white horse!
Please, someone save Nicole-chan~!?
m920142.助手ちゃんは優秀でね、ニコルちゃんが\n昼まで寝ようとすると起こしてくれるし、\:
My assistant is so talented. If Nicole-chan
tries to sleep until noon, she wakes me up,
makes breakfast, and most importantly, she's adorable……
m920142.呪術師さんに協力してもらって、\n鉱脈の封印が終わったからそのご報告だよー。:
I worked with the sorceress, and we've finished sealing the vein.
Just wanted to give you the report~.
m920142.大丈夫？ 怪我してないですか？\nあぁ、もうっ、無茶するんですから……！:
Are you alright? You're not hurt, are you?
Oh, you really do love taking risks……!
m920142.大切なお友達だもんね！！\n助手ちゃんは賢くて可愛くて最強の友達だよー！:
My precious friend, right!!
Assistant-chan is smart and cute and the strongest friend ever~!
m920142.封印とは言っても、\n鉱脈に続く道を呪術で隠しただけよ。\nニコルの研究がこれか:
Well, “sealing” just means
we used magic to hide the path leading to the vein.
So Nicole can continue her research as before.
m920142.少しの傷ならちょっとずつ治っていっちゃうし、\nすっごい打たれ強くなってるはず…:
Even minor wounds heal up little by little,
so they should be incredibly tough……!
After all, it's a gem that this Nicole-chan extracted!!
m920142.幸い、すぐ近くに王子達が遠征に来ています。\n欠片の効果を試す絶好の機会かと！:
Fortunately, the Prince and his party are on an expedition nearby.
It's a perfect opportunity to test the fragments' effects!
m920142.廃工場を襲撃してきたゴブリンが持っていた物です。\n失敗作らしくすぐに割れてしま:
They were carried by the Goblins who raided the abandoned factory.
They seem to be defective, as they shattered immediately, but
don't you feel an extraordinary power emanating from them?
m920142.待ちなさい！ 絶対逃さないんだから！！: Wait! We're not letting you escape!!
m920142.我々が遠征からの帰路だったのが、\n不幸中の幸いですね。\n王子、急ぎ救助に向か: It's a stroke of luck that we were returning from an expedition. Prince, let's hurry to the rescue!
m920142.持ってないし！ 教えないから～！！\nお姉ちゃーんっ！ よわよわ王子ぃーっ！ 助: I don't have it! And I'm not telling you~!! Sis~! Weakling Prince~! He――
m920142.王子、あちらには先程のゴブリンライダーに加え、\n浮遊戦車も控えているようです。:
Prince, in addition to the Goblin Riders from earlier,
it seems they have a floating tank on standby.
Please command with caution!!
m920142.王子、お姉ちゃん、\nエフネちゃんに、ニコルちゃん先生……！:
Prince, Sis,
Eithne, and Teacher Nicole……!
m920142.王子、こちらは既に包囲されています。\n慎重な指揮をお願いします！:
Prince, we are already surrounded.
Please exercise caution in your command!
m920142.目前のゴブリンの群れを倒さないと、\nあちらへは行けそうにないですね……。\n王:
We won't be able to cross over
until we deal with the goblins right in front of us, though……
Prince, let's hurry and defeat the monsters!
m920142.知ってる……よわよわ王子は、つよつよだから……。: I know…… the weakling Prince is actually super strong…….

There are indeed traces of a battle…….

What a fine display of leadership, Your Highness!!

I absolutely won't let that happen!

my preciou, preciou…… preciou……

All units, prepare for battle!
Drive the Prince and his party back!
I'll test the power of the Gold-Red Stone fragments right here!
m920142.美しさと強さを兼ね備えた宝石！\nまるで私みたいじゃないかしら？ オ～ッホッホッ:
A gem that combines beauty and strength!
Just like me, wouldn't you say? Ohohohoho!
m920142.自ら足止めだと説明してくれるとは。\n王子、助手殿のことが心配だ。\n早々に蹴散: How convenient that they announce their intentions themselves. Prince, I'm worried about the assistant. Let's crush them quickly.

I can fight without a care in the world!
m920142.良い師を得た、ということでしょうか。\n護衛はあの子に任せて問題なさそうです。\:
It seems she found a good mentor.
I can leave the escort duty to her without a worry.
My lord, as for the Goblin army——
m920142.良かったぁ！ 無事だったんだ！\nあっ、で、でも渓谷の向こうに行っちゃったー！？:
Oh, thank goodness!
She's safe!
Ah, b-but she's gone past the valley, isn't she!?
m920142.裏切るも何も、私は母さまの代からずっと、\n英雄王の系譜の味方なんだけどな……。:
It's no betrayal. I've been on the side of the Hero King's lineage

m920142.諦めない……か……。\nそうだな、諦めない、良い響きだ……。:
Not giving up…… huh…….
Yes, that's right. Not giving up. It has a nice ring to it…….
m920142.追跡は専門家にまかせておいてくれ。\n斥候と協力して、連中の逃走経路を割り出して:
Leave the pursuit to the professionals.
Let's work with the scouts to map out their escape route.

Looks like we made it in time.
Next time you need help, try calling out a bit sooner.
m920142.頼りにしてますよ、ユージェン。\nそれにしても、ダークエルフは\nまだ妖精郷への:
I'm counting on you, Yuugen.
Still, it seems the Dark Elves haven't given up on attacking the Fairyland after all……
m920142.高名ナル錬金術士殿にお褒めいただき恐悦至極。\n同じ研究者としテ、その努力と才能:
I am deeply honored to receive praise from such a renowned alchemist.
As a fellow researcher, I pay my respects to your efforts and talent.

I thought I heard you say that you were the one
who refined the “Sage's Aurumite”
that caused the monsters to be enhanced……?
m920142.（――くぅぅ。時間稼ぎニモならないカ。\n周囲に赤い結晶が増えている以上、\nコ:
(――Ugh. This isn't buying us any time.
With the red crystals multiplying around us,
it's certain that a vein is nearby!)
m920142.（――我々の気配に気づくトハ、\nさすがは王国軍と言うべきカ……）: (――To notice our presence... I suppose that's what you'd expect of the Royal Army...)
m920142.（これより鉱脈の探索に移ル！\nお前達は王子の足止めをするのダ！！）: (From now on, we'll move on to exploring the vein! You lot, hold the Prince back!!)

It's almost as if she's taken after the Prince……)

m920142.（早くアノ娘を捕まえテ、\n鉱脈の正確な位置ヲ吐かせねバ！！）:
(I need to catch that girl soon and
force her to reveal the exact location of the vein!!)

m920175.――あっ、それより殿下、今回の伝令は朗報ですよ。\n楽しいお祭りのお誘いです。:
――Ah, but more importantly, Your Highness, I have good news.
It's an invitation to a fun festival.

――Well, you are the bandit who protected the world from the Demon King, aren't you?
I think Leaf is a proper hero of justice.
m920175.――いや、教えてやる必要もあるまい。\nつい興が乗ってしまった。:
—No, I see no need to tell you.
I simply got carried away.
m920175.――おまつり！？\nま、まさか、ぴょんぴょんばにー祭りが復活ですかー！？:
――A festival!?
N-no way, is the Bounce-Bounce Bunny Festival making a comeback!?
m920175.――つがいのサンダーバード、だと？\nなるほど、伝承に残されていたのは、\nメス:
—A pair of Thunderbirds?
I see. The legends must have been about
the female Thunderbird.
m920175.――と言いつつ、まずはエッグパーティの準備じゃな♪\n特に子どもらには、祭りは超:
――That said, first things first: preparing for the Egg Party♪
Especially for the children, a festival is absolutely essential♪
m920175.――はぁ、なんだってこんな\nど田舎の世界樹なんかに……。:
――Haa, why did I have to come to this
backwater of a World Tree……
m920175.――ふぅ、そろそろ王国に到着ですね。: ――Phew, we should be arriving at the Kingdom soon.
m920175.――むかーしむかし、そのむかしー。\n兎の一族は、ハゲワシに\nめちゃくちゃ虐め:
――Once upon a time, in a land far, far away……
The rabbit clan was terribly bullied
by the vultures.
m920175.――もう手遅れみたいです！\n王子さん、あっちから鳥の大群がー！:
――It seems it's already too late!
Prince, a flock of birds is coming from over there!
m920175.――エッグパーティとは、\nかつて兎の一族を守ってくれたという、\n守護鳥への感: ――The Egg Party is a festival where we express our gratitude to the Guardian Birds, who once protected the Rabbit Clan.
m920175.――フッ、ニーヴ嬢、\nこういう時は無駄に胸を張って\n意味深な笑みを浮かべてお: ――Heh, Miss Neve, in times like this, one should puff out one's chest and wear a mysterious smile.
m920175.――仲間と共に歩み続けるって、\n口癖みたいに言う人なんです。:
—he always says, like a catchphrase,
that he'll keep walking forward with his comrades.
m920175.――実のところ、お前もこんな所に\n守護鳥の卵があるなんて思ってないんだろ？: ――Honestly, you don't really believe there are Guardian Bird eggs here, do you?
m920175.――王子、今日の訓練もお疲れさまです。\n軍全体の練度も、かなり向上してきました: ――Prince, thank you for your hard work in today's training. The overall proficiency of the army has improved significantly.
m920175.――親鳥が帰ってくるとは都合がいい。\n卵はここにあるって、教えているようなもん:
—It's convenient that the parent birds have returned.
It's practically telling us where the eggs are.
m920175.――闇の組織が、世界樹で何を企んでいるのでしょうか。: —What could the Dark Organization possibly be plotting at the World Tree?
m920175.――騒がしいと思えば、王国軍か。\nどうした、世界樹の災厄は解決したのだろう。:
—I thought it was noisy, but it's the Royal Army.
Well, what is it? Have you resolved the calamity of the World Tree?
m920175.…………このまま上へ向かう。\nツーが儲け話を隠してるなら、\nそいつをかっさら:
………… We're heading straight up.
If Two is hiding the profit, then
kidnapping him isn't such a bad idea, is it?
m920175.…………何？\nアイリーン、てめぇ、どんな情報を掴んでやがる。: ……What? Irene, what information do you have?
m920175.…………姐さん、追わないのか？: ………… Sis, aren't we going to chase them?
m920175.……あいつら、いつの間にロープなんか。\nくそっ、また逃げられたか……。:
……When did they get hold of ropes?
Damn it, they got away again…….
m920175.……えっぐぱーてぃ、ですよ？\nシュシュ、王国の皆さんに間違った名前を教えると、:
……It's an egg party, you know?
Shushu, if you teach the kingdom's people the wrong name,
it might end up being recorded as history…….
m920175.……そ、そう？ そうかな？\nボクも誰かのために戦ったりできるかな。:
……R-really?
Could I really fight for someone else?
m920175.……そうね、こんなに綺麗な卵飾り、\n壊されるのはちょっと癪だものね。:
……I suppose you're right. It would be a shame
if such beautiful egg decorations were to be destroyed.
m920175.……その言葉、信じるとでも？: ……And you expect us to believe that?
m920175.……それすら、ただの\nでまかせかもしれないぜ？:
……Even that might just be
a load of nonsense, you know?
m920175.……ち、違います。\n王子さんはお人好しで、すぐ駆け出しちゃう人だけど――:
……N-No.
The Prince is kind-hearted and tends to rush in, but—
m920175.……ちっ、こうも邪魔されちゃ\n商売上がったりだな。:
……Tch, getting in the way like this
is going to ruin my business.
m920175.……って、あれ？\n急にグリフィンが暴れだし――きゃぁっ！？\nいったいどうした: ...Wait, what's that? The griffins are suddenly acting wild――Kyaa!? What's going on?!
m920175.……でも、闇の組織が狙っているんだとしたら、\n絶対に守らないと。:
……But if the Dark Organization is targeting them,
we have to protect them at all costs.
m920175.……はぐれ者には優しく、正義には厳しく。\n昔気質の構成員も、随分と減っちまった: ……Kind to strays, strict with the righteous. There are so few members left with that old-school attitude.
m920175.……まぁ、攻撃しなくても、\nメスの雷は隠れている者にすら叩きつけられるだろうが:
……Well, even without attacking,
the female Thunderbird's lightning will strike
even those who are hiding!
But it's still best not to provoke her!
m920175.……もう少し内情を話してくれたら助かるのだがな。\n闇の組織の幹部がふたりも揃っ: ……It would help if you shared more details. Two executives of a shadow organization, searching for eggs in the World Tree…… What exactly are you plotting?
m920175.……もしかして、守護鳥さまの卵を狙って……？: ……Could they be after the Guardian Bird's eggs?
m920175.……やはり、お前に声をかけて正解だったか。\nフォーやシックスでは話がこじれてい:
……So it was the right call to bring you in.
Things were getting messy with Four and Six.
m920175.……俺の首ひとつでも、\nまだ釣り合わない金額だろうな。\n分かったら気合を入れ:
……It's an amount that wouldn't even balance out
against the value of my head.
If you understand that, then get to work. I'm leaving this to you.
m920175.……偶然邪魔なところにハゲワシがいたから、\n吹き飛ばしてみただけなんじゃないの:
……Maybe the vultures just happened to be in the way,
and it blew them away by accident?
m920175.……兎の仮装、ちょっとしてみたかったですけどね。: ……I would have liked to try on a rabbit costume for a moment, though.
m920175.……冷静にじゃなくて、冷徹に、か。\nまぁいい、こっちは先に撤退するぞ。:
……Ruthless, not just calm, huh.
Fine, I'm pulling out first.
m920175.……姐さんの口調の切り替え、\nやっぱちょっと慣れないなぁ。:
……Sis, the way you switch tones is
still a bit hard to get used to, you know.
m920175.……存外、ロマンティストなんだな。: ……I didn't expect you to be such a romantic.
m920175.……実在するんだろ、守護鳥の卵。\n兎の一族がご丁寧に守り続けてきたからこそ、\:
……The Guardian Bird's egg really does exist.
It's precisely because the Rabbit Clan has guarded it so diligently
that no one has ever found it, right here in the World Tree.
m920175.……悪趣味だな、ファイブ。\n小娘をからかって遊ぶとは。:
……What a tasteless joke, Five.
Toying with a little girl like that.
m920175.……正義、かぁ。\nでも、ちょっとカッコイイかもなぁ。:
……Justice, huh.
But it does sound a bit cool, doesn't it?
m920175.あぁ、王子殿下が模擬戦をしていたから、\n一緒に混ざりたくなっちゃったんですね？:
Ah, I see. Since His Highness was in the middle of a simulation,
you just wanted to join in, didn't you?
m920175.ああ、いい心がけだぞリーフ。\nそれでこそ正義の使者、\n白兎のぴょんぴょん戦士:
Ah, that's the spirit, Leaf!
Now that's the White Rabbit Hop-Hop Warrior Leaf,
the Messenger of Justice!!
m920175.ああ、そのつもりだ。\n――王子、この周囲には姿を隠した構成員がいるはずです。:
Yes, that is my intention.
――Prince, there should be members of the organization hiding nearby.
m920175.あたしは上り下りのしすぎでへとへとだけどね……。\nでも、卵飾りは可愛くて、なか:
I'm exhausted from all the climbing up and down, though……
But the egg decorations were cute, so it wasn't bad at all.
m920175.あっ……あぁー！！\nマリレーヌ！ これやばいやつじゃ！！\nラフレシアの親玉、:
Ah…… Aah!!
Marylene! This is bad!
It's the scent of the Hygreflesia, the leader of the Reflesia!
m920175.あっ、あぁー！ あれがハゲワシですよー！\nあの抱えてる岩を落として、\n卵飾り:
Ah, ah! Those are the vultures!
They're going to drop those rocks they're carrying
and smash the egg decorations, aren't they!?
m920175.あっ、ま、待ってください！\nボクももっと見つけますからー！！:
Ah, w-wait!
I'll find more too!!
m920175.あと一歩で雷光の速度にも至る剣技……。\nなるほど、闇の組織の幹部にも、\nここ:
A sword technique just one step away from the speed of lightning…
I see. So even among the officers of the Dark Organization,
there are masters of this caliber.
m920175.あはは……さすがに間違えはしないので……。\nあっ、でも一応併記しておきますね。:
Ahaha…… I'm sure they won't get it wrong…….
Ah, but I'll note both names just in case.
m920175.あはは、すみません……。\nこの子が王子殿下を見るなり、\nいきなり加速しちゃい:
Ahaha, I'm sorry…….
The moment this one saw His Highness,
he suddenly accelerated.
m920175.あやつは臭気でこっちを弱らせてくる。\n力も打たれ強さも落ちてしまうんじゃ。: It weakens us with its stench. Our strength and power will both diminish.
m920175.あれ、ニーヴさんって\nこのお祭りに乗り気じゃなかったんじゃ……。:
Oh, so Neve wasn't really looking forward
to this festival, were you……?
m920175.あれは……サンダーバードと、雷のかたまり？: Is that… the Thunderbird, and a ball of lightning?
m920175.い、いえ、何でも……。\n――あっ、ところで、何か甘ったるい香りがしませんか？: N-no, I didn't say anything……. Ah, by the way, don't you smell something sweet?
m920175.いいかい王子君、サンダーバードは敵じゃない。\n手を出すと容赦なく襲ってくるだろ:
Listen, Prince. The Thunderbird is not the enemy.
If you lay a hand on it, it will attack without mercy,
so do not get caught in its strikes!
m920175.いえ、雰囲気作りです。\nお気になさらず。:
No, I'm just setting the mood.
Please don't mind it.
m920175.いや、いい、気にするな。\n誰だってこんな僻地に来たいとは思わんだろう。:
No, it's fine, don't worry about it.
No one would want to come to a place like this.
m920175.いや、ニーヴ嬢もくすぐってほしいのかと？: Oh? Did you want me to tickle you too, Miss Neve?
m920175.いやぁ、一時はどうなることかと……。\nあやつの匂いは一ヶ月してもとれん、\nと:
Oh, for a moment there, I thought we were done for…….
That stench lingers for a month. It's incredibly stubborn.
m920175.いやぁ、闇の組織ってお金稼ぎが目的でしょ？\nそういう悪事はしないんじゃないかな:
Oh, the Dark Organization is in it for the money, isn't it?
I doubt they'd stoop to something like that.
m920175.うむうむ、頼んだぞクゥイルよ！\nさぁて、マリレーヌよ、\n吾輩たちは卵飾りの続: Good, good. I count on you, Quill! Now then, Marylene, let's get back to decorating the eggs!
m920175.うむうむ。\nみーんなぴりぴりしておったからなぁ。: Mm-hmm, indeed. Everyone was on edge.
m920175.うるせぇよ。\n組織に受けた恩を、部下に返しているだけだ。: Shut up. I'm just repaying the debt the organization owes my men.
m920175.うん、間違いない！\nあれ闇の組織の下っ端だよ！！:
Yeah, I'm sure of it!
That's one of the Dark Organization's underlings!!
m920175.えぇっ、兎さんの仮装をするの！？\n奇祭とは言わないけど、\n結構珍しいお祭りな: Ehh, dress up as rabbits? I wouldn't call it a bizarre ritual, but it is a pretty unusual festival, isn't it...?
m920175.えっ……エッグパーティに、\n王子殿下を誘ってもいいのでしょうか？: Hm? Invite His Highness to the Egg Party? Is that permitted?
m920175.えっ、えぇっ！？\nそんなこと言ってな――: Ehh, what?! I didn't say I was――
m920175.えっ、えっ、えぇー！！\nボクだけとか恥ずかし――あっ、タラニアさんと！\nニー: Ehh, ehh, really?! I'd be embarrassed if it were just me――Ah, Tarania's going too! And Neve! They seem interested!
m920175.えっ、な、なに！？\n着ないわよ！ 兎の仮装なんてしないわよ！？: Eh, w-what?! I'm not wearing it! I'm not dressing up as a rabbit!
m920175.えっぐぱーてぃ……？\nえぇっと、どんなお祭りなんです？:
Egg Party……?
Um, what kind of festival is it, exactly?
m920175.おかげで稼ぎやすくなったのは事実だが、\n同時に面倒な奴に絡まれる頻度も上がっち: It's made earning money easier, true enough. But it's also increased the frequency of troublesome people getting involved. ――Don't you think so, Irene?
m920175.おだまりなさい、セブン。\n敵が来ます、戦闘準備を！:
Keep quiet, Seven.
The enemy is approaching. Prepare for battle!
m920175.おっと……ところでクゥイルよ、\n王子のことはもう誘ったのか？: Oh, right…… Quill, have you invited the Prince yet?
m920175.き、奇祭じゃないですよぉ……？\nただ皆で兎の一族の仮装をして、\n卵飾りを隠し: It's not a bizarre ritual at all...? We just dress up as rabbits and hide and find egg decorations, that's all!
m920175.きゅっぴーん！\nおふたりも確保ですー！！: Kyuppin! I've secured the two of you!
m920175.こちらも粘るつもりはない。\n早々に立ち去るとしよう。……この仕事は、失敗だな。:
I have no intention of sticking around either.
Let's make our exit. ……This job is a failure.
m920175.このあたりには、\nまだ闇の組織は来ていないみたいだね……。:
It doesn't look like
the dark organization has come this far yet…….
m920175.こらこら、無理強いはだめだぞぉ？\nまぁでも、楽しいお祭りなのは確かかな。: Now, now, don't be pushy. But it is certainly a fun festival, I'll admit.
m920175.これに懲りてくれると良いのだけど……。\nいや、あの去り際の目つき、\n絶対また:
I hope this teaches them a lesson…….
No, judging by the look in their eyes as they left,
they'll definitely come back for the eggs…….
m920175.さぁて、それじゃあまずは王国軍の対処か。\n軍とやり合うとなれば分が悪いが、\n:
Well then, first things first: the Kingdom's army.
We're at a disadvantage if it comes to a full-on fight,
but if they only send a small force, we should be able to handle it.
m920175.さすがにサンダーバードが二羽もいると、\n卵を襲おうという者もいなくて、\n仲睦:
With two Thunderbirds present,
no one seems to dare attack the egg,
so they appear to be peacefully awaiting the moment of hatching.
m920175.さっき、あの枝の向こうに、\nちらっと誰かの姿が見えたんですよね。:
Just now, I caught a glimpse of someone
behind that branch.
m920175.しかし、正義とは常に過酷な運命にさらされるものだ。\n――気をつけろ！ ハゲワシ:
However, justice is always subject to a harsh fate.
—Watch out! A vulture is flying our way!
m920175.じゃあ兎の里へ移動しましょー！\n闇の組織もいなくなったし、\nぴょんぴょんばに:
Then let's move to Rabbit Village!

m920175.じゃろ、じゃろ。\nまぁ兎の仮装は若い者に任せるとして、\n吾輩らはこういうとこ: Of course, of course. I'll leave the rabbit costumes to the younger ones, but we must make our presence felt in other ways♪
m920175.せっかくツーの所へ案内してくれるんだ。\n泳がせて、一網打尽にした方が良いだろう:
They are kindly guiding us to Two.

m920175.せっかくボクらが来たんだから、\nお祭りを楽しみながら、\n卵飾りをしっかり守れ:
Since we've come all this way,
why don't we just enjoy the festival

m920175.せっかく作った卵飾りを割らせるわけにはいかないよ！\n王子さん、魔物の群れから卵:
We can't let them break the egg decorations we worked so hard on!
Prince, let's protect the egg decorations from the horde of monsters!
m920175.そうだな。\n前金だけで十分な稼ぎなんだ。\nあとは仕事をしたって実績だけ残して: Agreed. The advance payment is enough profit. We'll just do the work to leave a record of it.

So! As a way to repay the favor,

So that tradition has been passed down to the present day as a festival.

m920175.その時は、また兎の一族の里\n総出で歓迎しちゃいますよー！:
When that time comes, the entire Rabbit Clan village

m920175.それが、エッグパーティの卵飾り、だっけ？\n卵そっくりの飾りを作るんだよね。:
That's the egg decorations for the Egg Party, right?

m920175.それが嘘でも！ 信じると決めたのはボクなんだ！\nファイブさん、ツーさん、\nボ:

Five, Two,
We absolutely will not lose!!

Then, let's proceed to the final mock battle of the day.

m920175.それを探して、一番多く見つけた人には、\n守護鳥さまのご利益があるって言われてま:
It's said that whoever finds the most

m920175.それを言うのなら、見た目に反して部下思いなお前も、\n私からすれば意外なものだと: And you, who cares for your subordinates despite your rough exterior, are a surprise to me as well.

m920175.ただ、それ以来ハゲワシは腹いせに、\n守護鳥さまの卵を割るようになっちゃったんだ:
It's just that, ever since then, the vultures have been taking revenge
by cracking the Guardian Bird's eggs.
m920175.だが、守護鳥の卵はその手間をかけても\n惜しくない程の金が動くんだ。\n覚えてお:

Remember that, rookie.
m920175.ちっ……姐さん！ 先行してあいつを追う！\n王子たちを案内してくれ！:
Tch… Sis! I'm going ahead to chase him!
Guide the Prince and the others!

Tch…… We're outmatched against the Prince's regular army.
Let's keep them distracted and retreat.
m920175.ですですー。\n卵飾りで本物がどれか分からなくして、\n守護鳥さまの卵を守っちゃ:
That's right!

m920175.ですね。\nそれでは皆さん、拠点に戻りましょうか。:
She's right.
Then, everyone, let's head back to base.

Well, while Reve is writing, let's see…….
Fufu, I've found more egg decorations!
m920175.でも、王国軍の誰かとか、\n世界樹の人じゃなかったような気がして……。:
But it didn't look like anyone from the Royal Army,

m920175.でも！ そこに巨大な守護鳥さまがやってきて！\nハゲワシをばびゅーんと吹っ飛ばし:
But then! A giant Guardian Bird appeared!

m920175.でも！ だからって！\nこの格好は恥ずかしすぎると思わない！？:
But! Just because of that!
