m920175.となれば、ふふ、例えばこことか――！！: Which means, hehe, for example, right here――!!

That said, pushing too hard isn't good for anyone.

So the elders have insisted on inviting Your Highness

m920175.なるほど、確かに遠征や復興支援の頻度も増えていて、\nなかなか軍の皆さんに\n休:
I see. With the frequency of expeditions and reconstruction support increasing,

m920175.なるほどね……。\nよっし、じゃあ王子、急いで世界樹を登ろうぜ！:
I see…….
Alright then, Prince, let's hurry up and climb the World Tree!
m920175.なるほどね……。\n王子たちに知らせましょ。\nまた何か悪事を企んでいるに違いな:
I see…….
Let's inform the Prince.
They're definitely up to something shady.
m920175.は、はい……！\nところで、いったいどれくらいの額が……。:
Y-Yes……!
By the way, just how much are we talking about……?
m920175.はぁ……そのイチャつき、何回繰り返すのよ。\nって、待って、どうしてあたしに近寄:
Haa…… How many times do I have to put up with this flirting?
Wait, why are you getting so close to—
m920175.はぁ……はぁ……やっと解放されたぁ……。\n――ん、あれ？\nなんだか……変な気:
Haa…… haa…… I'm finally free…….
—Huh, what's that?
I can sense something…… off.
m920175.はぁぁ……こ、怖かったぁ……。\n雷、すごいバリバリいってましたよぉ……。:
Phew…… that, that was scary…….

m920175.はい、たくさん作って、\n王国の皆を驚かせてやりましょう。: Yes, sir. Let's make plenty and surprise everyone in the kingdom.
m920175.はいはい、じゃあ守護鳥さんの\n助けを求める声を聞き逃さないようにね。:
Yes, yes. Then make sure not to miss the Guardian Bird's
call for help.
m920175.ははっ、正義の音色だぞ、リーフ君。\n僕らの心に宿る、悪を打ち砕く勇気の音だ。:
Haha! That is the sound of justice, Leaf.
It is the sound of the courage that dwells in our hearts,
crushing evil.
m920175.ふぁ、ファイブ様！\nこの仕事に不満があるわけでは……！:
F-Five-sama!
I wasn't complaining about the job or anything……!
m920175.ふぁみりー同然……。\nふふっ、そういうことでしたら、\n急いでお誘いに行ってき: Practically family…… Heh, if that's the case, I'll hurry off and extend the invitation!
m920175.ふぅ……どうにか対処できましたね。: Phew…… We managed to deal with it.
m920175.ふっふっふ、さぁて、\n吾輩もひとつ、卵飾りを塗ってやるかのぉ。: Heh heh heh. Well then, I suppose I should paint an egg decoration myself.
m920175.ふっふっふ、我ら兎の一族に伝わる、\n話せば長い歴史と伝説があってですねぇ……！:
Heh heh heh, it is a tradition passed down through our rabbit clan,

m920175.ふっふっふー。\nまた次回も参加してくださいねー？:
Fu-fu-fu~.
Please come join us again next time, okay~?
m920175.ふっふっふー！\n王子さま、たっのしいお祭りにしましょうねー！: Hehehe! Prince, let's make it a fun festival!
m920175.ふっふー、ハゲワシ撃退ですー♪: Phew, the vultures have been driven off♪
m920175.ふふ、ラタトスク様が作るとなれば、\nきっと皆も喜ぶことでしょう。: Heh, if Your Majesty is making it, I'm sure everyone will be delighted.
m920175.ふふ、楽しみが増えましたね。\nともあれ、王子、此度の遠征もお疲れ様でした！:
Hehe, that adds to the excitement.

m920175.ふふっ、元気なヒナが生まれるといいわね。: Hehe, I hope healthy chicks are born.

Mm……if you're hiding a tree, you hide it in the forest.
If you're hiding an egg, you hide it in the Egg Party…….
m920175.ふむふむ、なるほどなるほど……。\nじゃあ、卵飾りを探しながら、\n魔物を退治し:
Mm-hmm, I see, I see…….

m920175.へ、変な名前つけないでぇ！？: H-Don't give me a weird name like that!?

Hm, so it was an act of justice!

Hmph, playing hero, are we?

m920175.ぼ、ボクは正義じゃないし！\n山賊だよ！？ 思いっきり悪だよー！！:

S-so it was too dazzling to see clearly,

m920175.まぁ、そこは僕の雷光で何とかしよう。: Well, I'll manage that with my lightning.

Well, even if we did try to rest,

m920175.もっと早く言いなさいよ馬鹿ぁっ！！\n王子、急いで迎撃準備を！:
Say that sooner, you idiot!!
Prince, get ready to intercept!
m920175.もはや探す手間も省けた。\nサンダーバードの卵は、我々がいただくとしよう。:
We've spared ourselves the trouble of searching.

Yaaay, yaaay, you ground-bound bunnies!

Waaah!? Stop! Stop it――!?
Wait, what……? Where is this……?

W-waa!!

Mm, Leaf-chan――no, Leaf-kun!

m920175.んー、卵飾り、卵飾り……。\nみんな隠すの上手いなぁ……。:
Hmm, egg decorations, egg decorations…….

Well, at the Egg Party,
everyone from the World Tree hides the egg decorations

m920175.エッグパーティとか久々じゃのぉ♪\nぴょんぴょっこぴょーん♪\nそーれぴょんぴょ:
It's been a while since the Egg Party♪
Hop-hop ko-pion♪
Here we go, hop-hop ko-pion♪
m920175.エッグパーティは世界樹の祭りじゃろ。\nで、王子は今や、世界樹のふぁみりー同然じ: The Egg Party is a festival of the World Tree. And the Prince is practically family to the World Tree now.
m920175.オスは巣を守り、子を守る霊鳥。\nそしてメスは、常に雷光を迸らせ、\nあらゆる外:

Quill!

The Thunderbird couple is currently
taking turns keeping the egg warm.
m920175.シュシュは本当に、エッグパーティが好きですね……。\nともかく、ここで立ち話とい:
Shushu really does love the Egg Party…….
Anyway, it's not appropriate to stand here chatting
while the soldiers are around……
m920175.ツー、あんたの儲け話にも\n一枚噛ませてもらいたいと思ってな。\n卵が実在するっ:
Two, I wanted to cut in on your profit-making scheme.

m920175.バチバチしてて眩しいです……っ。\nで、でも、雷の向こうに何かが見えるような……:
It's crackling and so bright…

m920175.ビフロストも起動したことじゃし、\n吾輩らもさらに頑張らねばのう！: Bifrost has been activated, after all. We must work even harder!
m920175.ファイブ、お前も来ていたか。\n前金で満足するかと思えば、仕事熱心なものだな。:
Five, so you've come too.
I thought you'd be satisfied with the advance payment, but you're quite dedicated to your work.
m920175.フォー程じゃないだろ。\nだが……面倒だな、時間稼ぎをされたか？\n気をつけろ、:
It's nothing compared to Four.

Watch out, the Thunderbird is descending!
m920175.フッ……当然だとも。\n正義の志とは、諦めない意志に宿るものなのだから。:
Hmph… Of course you can.

m920175.フッ……正義とはまばゆく輝くものだからねッ！！: Hmph… Justice is a dazzling light, after all!!

Heh, what a wonderful festival.
The Guardian Bird who did right, and the rabbit clan

m920175.フフッ、雷に不可能はない。\n正義を呼ぶ声に応えるものこそ、\n我がまばゆき天を:
Heh, there is nothing impossible with lightning.
What answers the call for justice is
my dazzling lightning that pierces the heavens.
m920175.ユグドラシルの危機が去っても、\nまだまだ気は抜けないということですか。: So even with the crisis to Yggdrasil over, we still can't let our guard down.
m920175.リーフ、何言い負かされてるのよ。\nあんたの憧れの王子さまは、\nひとりで戦って:
Leaf, don't just let her talk you down.
Is your idol, the Prince,

m920175.リーフちゃーん！\n一緒にエッグパーティしましょー！: Leaf-chan! Let's go to the Egg Party together!
m920175.世界樹とは今後も良好な関係を続けたいところだしね。\n――しかし、エッグパーティ: We do want to maintain a good relationship with the World Tree going forward. ――But, the Egg Party, is it? Hehehe, to think I'd get to attend that bizarre ritual I read about in an old book...
m920175.世界樹のお祭り、めちゃくちゃにはさせないよ！\n王子さーん！ 緊急事態ですー！！:
I won't let them ruin the World Tree festival!
Prince!— It's an emergency!!
--- scene: The Unknown Value of the Eggs (battle, end) ---
m920175.世界樹のふもとには人員を配置してある。\n……それでも追跡は難しいだろうが。:
We have personnel stationed at the base of the World Tree.
……It will still be difficult to track them, though.
m920175.世界樹の守護鳥、兎の一族を救ったという伝説、\nその正体こそ、雷鳴轟かす巨鳥、サ:

m920175.世界樹の災厄に対処するために、\nすべての部族がずっと臨戦態勢でしたからね。: Every tribe has been on high alert for quite some time, preparing to deal with the calamity threatening the World Tree.
m920175.世界樹の災厄に対抗するために、\nずいぶんと長い間開かれていなかった、\n世界樹:
To counter the calamity of the World Tree,

is making a comeback.

Far above the World Tree… that is…!
Could it be… a Thunderbird!?

The World Tree is huge, after all.

m920175.世界樹を燃やすとか、そういう……？: Burning the World Tree down, or something like……?
m920175.今回の件、闇の組織に破格の金が流れ込んでいる。\nありもしない卵を探すにしては、:
An abnormal amount of money is flowing into the Dark Organization for this job.
For searching for a non-existent egg,

This time, it's just a treasure hunt.

searching for an egg that doesn't exist.
m920175.代わりに、あのちんまいラフレシアなんかは、\n本体のヒュージラフレシアを枯らせば: However, if we wither the main body, the Hygreflesia, the smaller Reflesia will wither along with it.
m920175.何とかなんてさせないよ！\nサンダーバードさんの卵は、ボクらが守るんだから！:
We won't let you "handle it" so easily!

m920175.匂いだけならまだしも、\nこの辺りの植生まで変えてしまいますからね。: It's not just the smell, either. It changes the local vegetation.

If the egg is there……

It takes decades for the eggs to hatch…….

m920175.変な名前を付けないでください！\nあのお祭りには、エッグパーティという\n由緒正:

m920180.そんなことで私は満足よ。\n油は少し分けてくれると嬉しいかも。\nあとは子供たち:
That's all I need.
It would be nice if you could share a little oil, though.
And if you could help us search for the children...
m920180.たとえ人の形を捨てようとも、\n強さを求め変異することを選んだ、\nまっこと天晴:
Though they have cast off their human forms,
they chose to mutate in pursuit of strength.
Truly, they are ninjas of magnificent resolve.
m920180.だいたいねぇ──ひぃっ……！？\nいいい、いま……川に何か……！？:
Besides──Eek……!?

Th-there's…… something in the river……!?
m920180.だからそう言ってんだろがい。\nそもそも俺様は人間と関わりたくねぇんだ。\n自分:
I just said that, didn't I?
Besides, I don't want anything to do with humans.
Why would I go out of my way to make enemies?
m920180.だからってこんなの……普通じゃないわ……。: Even so, this is... not normal at all...
m920180.だって……みんな最近頑張ってたし、\n美味しいもの食べてほしいじゃない……。: I just…… everyone's been working so hard lately, and I wanted them to enjoy some good food……
m920180.だはははは！ 俺様を利用するのに、\n相撲に目を付けるたぁ中々慧眼じゃねぇか！\:
Hahahaha! Using me for sumo?
You've got a sharp eye, don't you!
Not bad, not bad! There are no bad guys among sumo fans!
m920180.ちょっと待って、肝試しに行ったんじゃ──: Wait, hold on, you went on a dare, didn't you──
m920180.ですがあの場にいた私や王子含め数人から、\n『戦場で手招きをするシラヌイさんを見:
But several people, including myself and the Prince who were on the scene,
gave witness testimony that they "saw Shiranui beckoning from the battlefield."
m920180.どうしたもこうしたもねぇな。\n近づけば怪物扱いで拒絶されるし、\n遠のけば油を:
It's not like I can help it.
If I get close, they reject me as a monster.
If I stay away, they start hunting me for my oil.
m920180.なかったことにするわよ！！: We're going to pretend that didn't happen!!
m920180.なっ……絡繰り忍者！？ なんでここに！: Wha... Karakuri Ninja!? What are you doing here!
m920180.なにぃ！？ 海産物お前……淡水育ちだったのか！？: What?! You're a sea creature… but you're a freshwater one?!
m920180.なにはともあれ一件落着──: In any case, it's all settled—
m920180.なに！？ なんなの！？ なんの話なの！？: What?! What is going on?! What are you talking about?!
m920180.なに？ 私たちは別に貴方を\nどうこうしようって気はないわよ？\n子供たちを見つ:
What? We're not here to do
anything to you, okay?
We'll head back as soon as we find the kids.
m920180.なるほど、愉快そうな方だ。\nそういうことなら構いませんよ。\n子供たちも喜ぶか:
I see. They seem like a cheerful sort.
If that's the case, I have no objections.
I think the children will be pleased too.
m920180.なんでそんなところに癒しの至宝があるのよ！\n大事な物ならちゃんと家に保管しとき:
Why is a healing treasure in a place like that!?

If it's something important, you should keep it safely at home!
m920180.なんと……詳しく教えてください。: Oh my…… Please, tell us more.
m920180.なんとか倒せましたね。もう大丈夫ですよ。: We managed to take it down. It's safe now.
m920180.ぬぉおおおお！？ 全て完璧にくり貫かれている！\nこれでは今日の売り上げが！ 売:
Whaaat?! They're all perfectly cut out!
This is going to ruin today's sales! My sales, aaah!
m920180.は、早く見つけて、早く帰りましょ！ ね？: L-let's find them quickly and get back! Okay?
m920180.はぁ……なにはともあれ、\nこれで無事にお祭りが開け──: Haa…… Well, in any case, the festival can finally──
m920180.はい、だから私は村長さんに会いに行きました。\n怪物の噂も、肝試しも、村長さんの: Yes, which is why I went to see the village chief. The rumors about the monster, the dare... it was all information coming from the village chief.
m920180.はい、宵越しのお金は持ちません。\nきっとその方が楽しいと思いますから。:
Yes, we don't keep money overnight.
I think it'll be much more fun that way.
m920180.はっけよーーーーい！！！！:
Haa-ke-ee-yo-o-o-o!!!
--- scene: Frog Sumo, Deep Forest Tournament (battle, battle) ---
m920180.はて、締めが甘かったのでしょうか……。: I wonder if the netting was a bit loose……
m920180.ふぅ、これで全部のようですね……。: Phew, I think that's all of them……
m920180.ふふっ、今日のために海でたくさんの\n食材を獲って来てくださいましたものね？: Heh, you did go out to sea and catch so many ingredients for today, didn't you?
m920180.ふむ、壺焼きと聞いていたがまさかの生とはな！\nだがそれもまた良し！ 相手にとっ:
Hmph. I was told it would be a roasted pot, but so it is alive!

Very well! I have no complaints about the opponent!
m920180.ふむ、我が麻痺毒を受けてまだ喋るか。\n恐るべき生命力、これは実験し甲斐のある─:
Hmph. You're still talking even after taking my paralytic poison?
Remarkable vitality. This will make for a worthwhile experiment—
m920180.へぇ……尋常な勝負の結果に異を唱えるんだ。\nこれは王国の公認賭博師として見逃せ:
Hm... objecting to the result of a fair fight.
As a kingdom-licensed gambler, I simply can't let that slide.
m920180.へへへ……負けた、負けたぜスキュレの姐さん。\nこの村のマスコットの座ァ、姐さん:
Hehehe… I lost, I lost, Skylle-san.
I'll cede the village mascot spot to you.
m920180.まあまあ落ち着いてください、スキュレさん。\nあれは霧で、あれは枯葉、あれは柳で:
Now, now, please calm down, Skylle.

That is fog, that is a dead leaf, and that is a willow.
m920180.まさか……変異技術を自分たちに施したのですか！？: No way... did they apply the mutation technology to themselves?!
m920180.まさかあいつ、人間まで口寄せしたの！？\nなによあれ……腕が蛇になってるじゃない:
No way, did that guy possess a human too?!
What is that... their arm has turned into a snake!
m920180.まだ始まってないのに元気ねぇ……。: You're all so energetic before it's even started……
m920180.みんな集まって！ 逃げられる前に全部捕まえるわよ！: Everyone, gather round! Let's catch them all before they get away!
m920180.よろしく頼むぜブラザー！\nとは言うがよ、受け入れるの早くねぇか？:
Nice to meet you, brother!
Though, I gotta say, that was a quick acceptance.
m920180.よーし、それじゃあみんなで帰りましょうか。: Alright then, let's all head home.
m920180.わ、私そんなつもりじゃ……。: I-I wasn't trying to say anything like that……
m920180.わっ！？ し、シラヌイさん……？\n今までどこにいらっしゃったんですか？:
Wha—? S-Shiranui...?
Where have you been all this time?
m920180.ん～ん、誓ってそこにはいなかったよ。: Hmm~ no, I swear I wasn't there.
m920180.アンモナイトクラーケンまで……\n思わぬ形で本日の目玉のご登場ですね。:
Even an Ammonite Kraken……
What an unexpected way for today's highlight to make its debut.
m920180.ガマガエルの油は古来より、\n傷薬として重宝されているんです。\n長く生きた個体:
Gamagairu oil has been highly valued as a medicine for wounds since ancient times.
The oil from older individuals is said to be even more effective.
m920180.サメか？ カニか？\n海水育ちがそんなに偉ェのか！？\n淡水育ちは怖くねぇってか:
Are you a shark? A crab?
Do you think being raised in salt water makes you better than us?
Freshwater folks aren't afraid of you!
m920180.シラヌイさんにお聞きします。\n私たちが絡繰り忍者と戦っているとき、\nシラヌイ:
I'll ask Shiranui.
While we were fighting the Karakuri Ninja,
weren't you not there either, Shiranui?
m920180.テメェら海産物はいつもそうだ！\n海の中だけで全てを知った気になって、\n河川や:
You sea creatures are always like this!
Acting like you know everything just because you live in the ocean,
and looking down on us who live in rivers and lakes!
m920180.ニンゲンメ……コンドハナニヲスルツモリダ？: Human…… what do you intend to do?
m920180.モシ、タチサラナイノナラ──: If you don't move out of the way──
m920180.リアナはどうしてそんなに落ち着いてるのよ！？: Why are you so calm, Liana!?
m920180.井の中の狭さも知らねぇ奴らに、\n俺様の油を渡すわけにゃあいかねぇ！\n行くぜブ:
You guys who don't even know how narrow a well can be,
I'm not about to let you take my oil!
Let's go, brother! It's time to wrestle!
m920180.人を守るために、人であることを捨て、\nそれ故に人から拒絶された、哀れな姫君よ。:
A pitiful princess who abandoned her humanity to protect others,
and was cast out by them for it.
m920180.人間を攫う怪物の噂です。\nガマガエルさんは違いました。\nでは、怪物の正体は何:
The rumors about a monster abducting humans.
Gamagairu was not it.
So, what is the true identity of the monster?
m920180.何も知らないくせに掘り返すんじゃないわよ。: Don't you dare dig up my past when you know nothing about it.
m920180.何やってんだよ王子！ 村のみんな……！\n俺たちというものがいながら誰だよその妖:
What are you doing, Prince? Everyone in the village…!
Who is this yōkai, while we're right here?
m920180.何を驚くことがある。\nお主も似たような代物であろう。:
What is there to be surprised by?
You are no different, in the end.
m920180.俺様は俺様の油を搾取しようとする、\nクソみてぇな人間たちから逃げ出して、\n最:
I fled from those wretched humans who tried to exploit my oil,
and recently moved into this forest, but……
m920180.再び相見えたな、王国軍よ。\nしかし、今宵の標的はお主らではない。\n協力には感:
We meet again, Kingdom soldiers.
However, my target tonight is not you.
I appreciate the cooperation, but please stay out of this.
m920180.分からぬか、見ての通りの妖怪退治よ。\nこれほどの個体のガマ油はもはや霊薬に近い:
You can't tell? It's a monster hunt, as you can see.
Oil from a specimen this large is practically a miracle drug.
It's a source of funds and research material. The possibilities are endless.
m920180.別に、私も似たような経験があるってだけ。\n安っぽい同情心よ、もしかして怒るかし:
Don't read into it. I've just had a similar experience myself.
It's cheap sympathy. Are you going to get angry about it?
m920180.別にマスコットになりたくて\n戦ってたわけじゃないんだけど？: I wasn't fighting to become a mascot, you know?
m920180.加えて本体の性能も中々に悪くない。\n実験にて変異させれば強力な戦力と成り得る。:
Moreover, the main body's performance is quite good.
If we mutate it in experiments, it could become a powerful force.
Truly, there's no part of this toad that isn't useful.
m920180.協力した覚えは一切ありませんが、\n今日はいったい何を企んでいるのです！:
I never agreed to cooperate with you!
What are you plotting today?
m920180.口を閉じなさい、それ以上の侮辱は許しませんよ。\nスキュレさんは貴方が思うよりも:
Hold your tongue. I will not tolerate any further insults.
Skylle is far stronger than you could ever imagine.
m920180.命を助けてもらっておいて、\nそんな無様な真似はしねぇよ。:
After you saved my life,
I'm not going to do something so ridiculous.
m920180.噛み砕き、呑み喰らう。\nその身に宿すは蛇毒の異形。\n忍法、口寄せの術──変異:
I shall crush and devour.
An aberration harboring snake venom within its body.
Ninjutsu: The Art of Possession──Mutation Zone!
m920180.大丈夫ですよ、私たちに任せてください。: It's all right. Please leave it to us.
m920180.大当たりだ、拙者からも景品をくれてやろう。: A big hit. I shall give you a prize from me as well.
m920180.失礼ね。元はれっきとした人間よ、一応ね。: How rude. I was a perfectly respectable human, once.
m920180.子供たちは何処まで行ったのよぉ……\n王子、絶対に手を離したら駄目だからね？:
Where on earth did the children go……
Prince, you absolutely must not let go of my hand, okay?
m920180.実はこの村の近くの森にある川には、\n昔から人間を攫う怪物が棲み付いとりまして、:
You see, there's a river in the forest near our village.
A monster that abducts humans has lived there for ages, and we've always told the villagers to stay away from it……
m920180.射的の景品が、全部……全部持って行かれた……。: All the prizes from the ring toss... they're all gone...
m920180.待ってくれ！ あんたは命の恩人だ！\n借りを返さずに帰しちまったら、俺様一生の恥:
Wait! You're the one who saved my life!
If I let you go without repaying that debt, I'd be disgraced for life!
Anything! Is there anything I can do?!
m920180.怒るのはそこなのですね。\nいえ、私も同意見なのですが。:
So that is what angers you.

I agree with you, though.
m920180.怖いのはもういやなの！！\nだから今日は何もなかったの！！:
I'm done being scared!!
So nothing happened today!!
m920180.怖い怖い怖い怖い……なんなのよここは！？\nこんなに不気味だなんて聞いてないんだ:
Scary, scary, scary, scary…… What is this place!?

No one told me it would be this creepy!
m920180.悪ガキたちが肝試しや言うて、\nその川に何人かで向こうたらしいのです。\nそれか:
But some of the rascals decided to go on a dare and headed toward the river.
They haven't shown any sign of returning since……
m920180.折角の夏祭り、今日の屋台の売り上げで、\n鬼刃姫に豪遊してもらいたかったのです…:
We wanted to use today's stall revenue
to let Kibahime splurge a little at the summer festival...
m920180.提灯おばけさん！？ こっ、これは違うんだ！！: Lantern Ghost?! T-this is a misunderstanding!!
m920180.提灯おばけ対ガマガエル。\n喧嘩の勝者はスキュレってことで、\n賭け金は胴元の総:
Lantern Ghost versus Gamagairu.
Since Skylle won the fight,
the house takes all the bets, right?
m920180.日傘を片手に戦う浴衣の金魚姫……売れる！: A goldfish princess in a yukata, fighting with a parasol… this will sell!
m920180.村のマスコットの座は渡さない！ 勝負だガマガエル！: I'm not giving up the village mascot spot! It's a match, Gamagairu!
m920180.森の中にお城が……これは、幻術？: A castle in the middle of the forest... is this an illusion?
m920180.気になって村の人たちに聞いたのですが、\n返答は一つでした『そんな噂は知らない』: I asked the villagers about it, but they all gave the same answer: "We've never heard of any such rumor." So, they had no prejudice against Gamagairu.
m920180.気をつけて！ あいつ何かやるつもりだよ！: Be careful! He's about to do something!
m920180.決まり手は日傘での殴打！\n日傘での殴打でスキュレの勝ち！:
The winning move is a strike with a parasol!
Skylle wins by striking with a parasol!
m920180.河童が森の入り口辺りで脅かしゃあ、\n大抵の人間はすぐに尻尾巻いて村に逃げ帰る。:
When the Kappa threatens them at the forest entrance,
most humans immediately turn tail and run back to the village.
Kids are even more likely to. I haven't seen them, though.
m920180.海魔の力……中々に厄介なれども、\nしかし、全く弱点がないわけではない。:
The power of the Sea Demon... it is quite troublesome,
but it is not without weaknesses.
m920180.然り、我が研究は次の段階へと至った。\n此奴らはその先駆け、果て無き武の求道者。:
Indeed. My research has reached its next phase.
These creatures are its vanguard, seekers of infinite martial prowess.
m920180.王子や国主代理、妖怪総大将のおかげで、\n最近の東の国は人間と妖怪の融和が進んで:
Thanks to the Prince, the Regent, and the General of the Yōkai,
the East Kingdom has been making great strides in human-yōkai harmony lately.
I'll admit, the Prince's introduction helped a lot, though.
m920180.生憎とこちらにも事情がありまして。\nおいそれと帰るわけにもいけないのです。:
Unfortunately, we have our own circumstances.

We cannot simply turn back.
m920180.申し訳ない、私たちではどうにも手が出せんで……。: I'm sorry. We're powerless to do anything about it……
m920180.砕かれるのは貴方の絡繰りの方よ。\n守るための戦いで、私はもう負けない。:
It's your contraptions that will be shattered.
In a fight to protect others, I will not lose anymore.
m920180.確と心に響いたぜブラザー、\n気合の入った良い打撃だった！:
That really hit the spot, brother.
That was a spirited strike!
m920180.私たちは子供たちが行方不明と聞いて、\nこの森に救助にやって来たのですが……。:
We heard that the children had gone missing,
so we came to this forest to rescue them……
m920180.私も少し調子に乗りすぎちゃったかも……。: I might have gotten a bit carried away, too...
m920180.絡繰り忍者、撤退していきます。\n追うのは……やめておきましょうか。:
The Karakuri Ninja is retreating.
Let's not... pursue them.
m920180.荒々しき魔力をその身に宿そうと、\nその精神は所詮、箱の中が似合いの小娘。\n大:
You seek to harbor wild magical power within your body,
yet your spirit is that of a girl best suited to a box.
You would have been happier staying safely at home.
m920180.貴方はそんな悪い子じゃないみたいだし、\nきっと村の人たちと仲良くなれると思うの:
You don't seem like a bad guy at all,
so I think you'll get along just fine with the villagers.
m920180.賛成、すっごく疲れちゃったし。\nそもそもの目的はあれじゃないしね。:
Agreed. I'm completely exhausted.
Besides, that wasn't really the point of this, was it?
m920180.足が震えているぞ、海魔の娘。\n蛇は苦手か、それとも同族嫌悪か。\n過去の記憶を:
Your legs are trembling, daughter of the sea demon.
Do you fear snakes, or is it a hatred of your own kind?
It must be painful to recall the past.
m920180.退避！ すぐに周辺から退避してください！: Evacuate! Please move away from the area immediately!
m920180.違うって言ってるでしょ！？: I'm telling you, that's not it!
m920180.金魚姫？ スキュレって金魚のお姫様なのか？: The Goldfish Princess? Is Skylle a goldfish princess?
m920180.鬼刃衆のおじさん。\n型抜き、全部終わりました。\n換金の方をお願いします。:
Uncle Oni Blade Squad.
I've finished cutting out all the shapes.
Please process my exchange.
m920180.魔神の欠片ではないからノーカンだ！\nそれよりもこれだけの損失を出しておきながら:
It's not a fragment of a Demon God, so it's a no-go!
Besides, after causing this much damage,
how can I go back to Kibahime with a straight face!
m920180.（……するとおかしいですね、\n確かに戦場でシラヌイさんを見掛けたのですが、\n:
(That's strange...
I definitely saw Shiranui on the battlefield,
but perhaps I was mistaken...)
m920180.（……たくさんの人に囲まれて、笑顔が溢れて。\nそれこそが本来の貴方の姿です、ス:
(…Surrounded by so many people, overflowing with smiles.
That is your true form, Skylle-san.)
m920180.（いつか貴方が、今の貴方を、\n心の底から好きになれますように。\n星空が、叶え:
(I hope that one day, you will come to
love the person you are now, from the bottom of your heart.
I wish the starry sky would grant that wish.)
m920180.（なにか、嫌な予感がするような……）: (I have a bad feeling about this……)
m920180.（ふむ……先客がいたでござるか）: (Hmph... looks like we have some company.)
m920180.（海産物のやろう……足が震えて……）: (That seafood brat... his legs are shaking...)
m920180.（驚くと同時に王子への自然なボディタッチ、\n完璧です……中々にやりますね、スキ:
(A natural body touch to the Prince upon being startled.

Perfect…… You really are something, Skylle)

m920238.――あの後、\nカボチャの魔物とカブの魔物は、\n大人しく帰っていったよ。:
――After that,
the Pumpkin Monster and the Turnip Monster
gave up and went home.
m920238.――ここは協力して、一緒に敵を倒すカボ！！:
――Let's work together and take down this enemy, kab!!

m920238.――さぁ、行くよ！\nくまさんパワーで、暴れん坊な野菜たちを、\n懲らしめちゃう:
――Alright, let's go!
With the power of a bear,
I'm going to put those rowdy vegetables in their place!!
m920238.――ずっと思っていたのですが、\nベアッカさんの武装、すごいことになっていますね: I've been meaning to ask, but Bearca, your equipment is quite something.
m920238.――ではこれより、戦闘訓練を開始します！: ――Now then, let us begin the combat training!
m920238.――どうやら追い詰めすぎたようですね。\nカボチャとカブが手を組んでしまいました:
――It seems we pushed them too hard.
The Pumpkins and Turnips have formed an alliance.
m920238.――カ～ブカブカブカブ！\n惨めでカブねぇ、カボチャの魔物！:
――Kab~ kab kab kab!
How pitiful you are, kab, you Pumpkin Monster!
m920238.――ビフロンス様が消滅した以上、\nボクらはもう終わりカボ。:
――With Bifrons gone,
